description: 考研英语一同源外刊例句精编题库（100 题，均衡覆盖全部 7 大可刷题模块；全部摘自 The Guardian / The Conversation / Aeon 真实公开文章，仅引用单句并附完整出处与原文链接）

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 及物与不及物
questions.instruction: 四个动词词形词义均相近，结合句中不及物语境与“心身疾病产生”的搭配，选出最恰当的一项：
questions.prompt: What this could point to is that psychosomatic illnesses ______ not because of what a patient is doing with their emotions, but because of what they have not been able to do with them.

options.explain: 正确。arise 为不及物动词，意为“（问题/疾病/分歧）产生、出现”，后面不接宾语，完美匹配 psychosomatic illnesses 作主语。
错误。arouse 为及物动词，意为“唤起、激发（情感/怀疑）”，后面必须接宾语（或用被动）。
错误。raise 为及物动词，意为“提高、筹集、提出”，不能作不及物谓语。
错误。rise 虽为不及物动词，但指物理高度、价格或数量“上升/上涨”，不用于抽象表示“疾病产生源于……”。

source.sentence: What this could point to is that psychosomatic illnesses arise not because of what a patient is doing with their emotions, but because of what they have not been able to do with them.
source.title: How can we explain psychosomatic illnesses?

syntax.backbone: [What this could point to] (主语从句) + is (系) + [that psychosomatic illnesses arise not because of ... but because of ...] (表语从句)

segments.text: not because of what a patient is doing with their emotions,
segments.label: 原因状语1（not...）

segments.text: but because of what they have not been able to do with them.
segments.label: 并列转折原因状语2（but...）

translation.literal: 这可能指向的是，心身疾病的产生不是因为病人正在对他们的情绪做什么，而是因为他们未能对情绪做什么。
translation.polished: 这或许表明，心身疾病之所以产生，并非源于患者对自身情绪采取了何种处理方式，而是源于他们未能妥善消化这些情绪。
translation.keyPoint: 全句嵌套三个名词性从句（what 主语从句 + that 表语从句 + 两个 what 介词宾语从句）；not because of A, but because of B 译为“并非源于……而是源于……”。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 医疗对象差异
questions.instruction: 四个词均含“治/修补”之意，结合“药物帮助预防和治疗癌症”的医学表达，选出最准确的一项：
questions.prompt: A series of studies indicated that GLP-1 medications could help prevent and ______ cancer, with one finding that those who took the drugs were 30% less likely to develop breast cancer.

options.explain: 错误。heal 侧重外伤、伤口或情感裂痕“（自然）愈合”，医学上通常不说 heal cancer。
正确。treat 侧重“治疗（疾病/病人）”的医学干预过程，不夸大为彻底根治，最符合外刊严谨科研表述。
错误。remedy 侧重“补救、纠正（制度缺陷/社会弊端/错误局势）”，一般不直接搭配 cancer。
错误。mend 多指修补破损衣物、器物或缓和人际关系（mend fences），不用于癌症治疗。

source.sentence: A series of studies indicated that GLP-1 medications could help prevent and treat cancer, with one finding that those who took the drugs were 30% less likely to develop breast cancer.
source.title: Monday briefing: Are we any closer to a cure for cancer?

syntax.backbone: A series of studies (主) + indicated (谓) + [that 宾语从句] + [with one finding ... 伴随状语]

segments.text: that GLP-1 medications could help prevent and treat cancer,
segments.label: 宾语从句 O

segments.text: that those who took the drugs were 30% less likely to develop breast cancer.
segments.label: 宾语从句（含 who 定语从句）

translation.literal: 一系列研究表明，GLP-1 药物可能有助于预防和治疗癌症，其中一项研究发现，服用这些药物的人患乳腺癌的可能性低 30%。
translation.polished: 一系列研究表明，GLP-1 类药物或许有助于预防和治疗癌症；其中一项研究发现，服用该类药物的人群罹患乳腺癌的风险降低了 30%。
translation.keyPoint: one 指代 one study；develop + 疾病 译为“患上/罹患（某病）”；30% less likely to... 译为“患病风险低 30%”。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 固定结构搭配
questions.instruction: 结合后面的介词 from 构成“把 A 与 B 区分开”的语境，选出最准确的一项：
questions.prompt: One algorithm was more than 90% accurate at ______ the US from Scottish spirits, though the performance would be likely to drop against tipples it had not been trained on.

options.explain: 正确。distinguish A from B 是最经典的“把 A 与 B 区分开”搭配，精准呼应后文 from Scottish spirits。
错误。discriminate 表“区分”时常接 between A and B（discriminate between），接 against 则表“歧视”，极少直接用 discriminate A from B。
错误。identify 意为“识别确认（单一身份或原因）”，不构成 identify A from B 结构。
错误。clarify 意为“澄清说明（概念/误解）”，与算法分辨酒类香气无关。

source.sentence: One algorithm was more than 90% accurate at distinguishing the US from Scottish spirits, though the performance would be likely to drop against tipples it had not been trained on.
source.title: AI learns to distinguish between aromas of US and Scottish whiskies

syntax.backbone: One algorithm (主) + was (系) + more than 90% accurate (表) + [though 让步状语从句]

segments.text: at distinguishing the US from Scottish spirits,
segments.label: 方面状语（动名词短语）

segments.text: though the performance would be likely to drop
segments.label: 让步状语从句

segments.text: against tipples it had not been trained on.
segments.label: 对象状语（含省略 that 的定语从句）

translation.literal: 一种算法在区分美国烈酒和苏格兰烈酒方面的准确率超过 90%，尽管在面对它未经训练的酒类时表现可能会下降。
translation.polished: 其中一款算法在区分美国烈酒与苏格兰烈酒时准确率超过 90%，但面对此前未经训练的酒品时，其表现可能会有所下滑。
translation.keyPoint: spirits 此处为熟词生义“烈酒”；tipples 指“酒类饮品”；it had not been trained on 为定语从句修饰 tipples。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 政策实施搭配
questions.instruction: 四个词均含“执行/落实”之意，选出最适合搭配政府预算“贯彻实施校园手机禁令”的一项：
questions.prompt: The budget bill, which the government will submit next week, allocates 95m kronor (£7.52m) for 2026 and 100m kronor the following year to ______ the phone ban.

options.explain: 错误。fulfill 侧重“履行（诺言/职责）”或“满足（条件/期待）”，不搭配 policy/ban 表示落地推行。
正确。implement 专指“贯彻实施（政策/改革/计划/禁令）”，是外刊政经类最核心的动词搭配。
错误。execute 侧重“执行（具体命令/军事行动/死刑/程序代码）”，语气偏指令操作而非公共政策落地。
错误。comply 为不及物动词，意为“遵从（规则）”，且须加介词 with。

source.sentence: The budget bill, which the government will submit next week, allocates 95m kronor (£7.52m) for 2026 and 100m kronor the following year to implement the phone ban.
source.title: Sweden to implement nationwide mobile phone ban in schools

syntax.backbone: The budget bill (主) + allocates (谓) + 95m kronor ... and 100m kronor ... (宾) + [to implement 目的状语]

segments.text: which the government will submit next week,
segments.label: 非限制性定语从句

segments.text: 95m kronor (£7.52m) for 2026 and 100m kronor the following year
segments.label: 并列宾语 O

translation.literal: 这份政府将于下周提交的预算案，为 2026 年划拨 9500 万克朗（752 万英镑）并在次年划拨 1 亿克朗，以实施这项手机禁令。
translation.polished: 政府将于下周提交的这份预算案拟在 2026 年划拨 9500 万克朗（约合 752 万英镑），并在次年再拨款 1 亿克朗，用于推行这项校园手机禁令。
translation.keyPoint: bill 为熟词生义“法案/议案”；allocate 意为“划拨（预算/资金）”；非限制性定语从句较短，译作前置定语更利落。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 评估对象区分
questions.instruction: 四个词都带“估/评”之意，结合宾语“董事会潜在候选人”选出最恰当的一项：
questions.prompt: Goldman Sachs is removing race, gender and other diversity-related considerations when ______ prospective candidates for its executive board after pressure from an activist shareholder group to remove the criteria.

options.explain: 错误。estimate 侧重对数量、成本、时间等数值进行“粗略估算”，不能用于评价候选人。
错误。appraise 多用于专家对房产、艺术品等资产进行“估价鉴定”（虽偶尔用于绩效考评，但在招聘筛选候选人时不如 evaluate 自然常见）。
正确。evaluate 意为“综合评价、评判（候选人/方案/绩效的优劣与资格）”，与 prospective candidates 和 criteria 严丝合缝。
错误。calculate 意为“数学计算”或生义“打算”，不能搭配 candidates。

source.sentence: Goldman Sachs is removing race, gender and other diversity-related considerations when evaluating prospective candidates for its executive board after pressure from an activist shareholder group to remove the criteria.
source.title: Goldman Sachs to drop race, gender and LGBTQ+ criteria from board evaluations

syntax.backbone: Goldman Sachs (主) + is removing (谓) + considerations (宾) + [when evaluating ... 时间状语] + [after pressure ... 原因/时间状语]

segments.text: race, gender and other diversity-related considerations
segments.label: 宾语 O

segments.text: when evaluating prospective candidates for its executive board
segments.label: 省略主语的时间状语

segments.text: after pressure from an activist shareholder group
segments.label: 时间/原因状语

translation.literal: 在遭到一个激进股东团体要求取消相关标准的施压后，高盛在评估其执行董事会潜在候选人时，正在移除种族、性别和其他与多元化相关的考量。
translation.polished: 在一个维权股东团体施压要求取消相关标准后，高盛正准备在评估执行董事会潜在人选时，剔除种族、性别及其他多元化考量因素。
translation.keyPoint: 顺带串联 3 个考研核心词：prospective（潜在的，区别于 perspective）、board（董事会，熟词生义）、criteria（criterion 的复数，评判准则）。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 缓解搭配
questions.instruction: 结合宾语“选民的经济压力”与双破折号插入结构，选出最地道的一项：
questions.prompt: The economy itself – driven almost exclusively by a frenzied artificial intelligence investment boom – is unlikely to help Democrats achieve their goal of ______ voters' economic strains.

options.explain: 错误。soothe 侧重“安抚哭闹情绪、舒缓局部疼痛（如喉痛/肌肤）”，不常与宏观经济压力 economic strains 搭配。
正确。ease strains/pressures/tensions 是外刊经济报道最高频搭配，意为“缓和、减轻（压力/紧张局势）”。
错误。cure 意为“治愈疾病”，修饰 economic strains 搭配不当。
错误。subdue 意为“制服、压制（叛乱/对手情绪）”，不符合帮选民缓解经济负担的语境。

source.sentence: The economy itself – driven almost exclusively by a frenzied artificial intelligence investment boom – is unlikely to help Democrats achieve their goal of easing voters' economic strains.
source.title: Trump may have lost but don’t bet Democrats can fix the economy

syntax.backbone: The economy itself (主) + is (系) + unlikely to help Democrats achieve their goal (表)

segments.text: – driven almost exclusively by a frenzied artificial intelligence investment boom –
segments.label: 双破折号过去分词插入定语

segments.text: unlikely to help Democrats achieve their goal
segments.label: 表语 C
介词后置定语（解释 goal）

translation.literal: 经济本身——几乎完全由狂热的人工智能投资热潮驱动——不太可能帮助民主党实现缓解选民经济压力的目标。
translation.polished: 经济本身几乎完全靠狂热的人工智能投资潮拉动，因此不太可能助推民主党实现缓解选民生活成本压力的目标。
translation.keyPoint: 双破折号构成典型英一主谓隔离结构；frenzied 意为“狂热的”；strains 指“（经济或心理）压力、重负”。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 放弃对象区分
questions.instruction: 四个词均含“放弃/丢弃”之意，结合“两国放弃联合战机项目”的正式新闻语境，选出最准确的一项：
questions.prompt: France and Germany have concluded that the companies involved in building a joint fighter jet will not be able to reach an agreement and have ______ the project, officials in Berlin have said in a blow to Europe's common defence efforts.

options.explain: 错误。desert 带有强烈的“违背义务而擅离职守/抛弃家人或阵地”贬义，不用于政府决定中止合作项目。
错误。discard 多指像丢废品一样“扔掉无用物件或过时想法”，不如 abandon 契合大型工程/计划。
正确。abandon a project/plan/policy 专指“因困难或条件不成熟而正式放弃某项计划/工程”，是标准书面搭配。
错误。quit 多指个人“辞职、退学或戒掉恶习”（且现代美式过去分词多用 quit），不搭配国家级联合项目。

source.sentence: France and Germany have concluded that the companies involved in building a joint fighter jet will not be able to reach an agreement and have abandoned the project, officials in Berlin have said in a blow to Europe's common defence efforts.
source.title: France and Germany abandon joint project to build European fighter jet

syntax.backbone: France and Germany (主) + have concluded [that 从句] (谓1+宾1) + and + have abandoned (谓2) + the project (宾2)

segments.text: that the companies involved in building a joint fighter jet will not be able to reach an agreement
segments.label: 宾语从句 O1（含过去分词定语）

segments.text: in a blow to Europe's common defence efforts.
segments.label: 结果评价状语

translation.literal: 柏林官员表示，法国和德国已得出结论，参与建造联合战斗机的公司将无法达成协议，并已放弃该项目，这对欧洲共同防务努力造成打击。
translation.polished: 柏林方面官员表示，法德两国已认定参与联合战机研发的企业无法达成一致，遂决定放弃该项目——这无疑给欧洲共同防务构想带来沉重打击。
translation.keyPoint: in a blow to... 意为“给……带来沉重打击”；conclude 此处意为“断定、得出结论”；引语归属主句译至句首更合中文习惯。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 资源划拨搭配
questions.instruction: 四个词均含“分配”之意，结合“将政府议程时间划拨给某法案”的语境，选出最准确的一项：
questions.prompt: That would require Starmer to ______ some government time to the bill, or supporters to win another slot in the private members' bill ballot to table the bill again.

options.explain: 正确。allocate A to B 专指“统筹划拨（预算/资金/稀缺时间/资源）给某项目或用途”，是政经外刊最精准搭配。
错误。distribute 侧重将物资、传单或财富“分发、散布”给多个分散个体，不搭配给单一法案拨出议会时间。
错误。assign 多指“分派（具体工作任务、职位或作业）”给某人。
错误。disperse 意为“驱散（人群）、消散（云雾）”，并非统筹分配资源。

source.sentence: That would require Starmer to allocate some government time to the bill, or supporters to win another slot in the private members' bill ballot to table the bill again.
source.title: Starmer unlikely to allocate more time for assisted dying bill, ministers believe

syntax.backbone: That (主) + would require (谓) + [Starmer to allocate ...] or [supporters to win ...] (并列宾语+不定式宾补)

segments.text: Starmer to allocate some government time to the bill,
segments.label: 宾语+宾补1

segments.text: in the private members' bill ballot
segments.label: 介词后置定语

translation.literal: 那将要求斯塔默为该法案划拨一些政府时间，或者支持者在议员个人法案抽签中赢得另一个名额以再次提交该法案。
translation.polished: 这意味着要么需要斯塔默为该法案划拨部分政府议事时间，要么支持者得在后座议员法案抽签中再中一签，才能重新将该法案提上议程。
translation.keyPoint: 顺带复习熟词生义 table（英式《卫报》中 table a bill 意为“正式提交议程讨论”，而在美式英语中相反指“搁置”）！

questions.examFocus: 固定搭配 · 介词经典陷阱
questions.instruction: 选出表示“在于、本质上是”的固定动词介词搭配（考研完形最高频介词陷阱之一）：
questions.prompt: In other words, mathematics ______ the ideas living in human brains, with new theorems serving as markers for our progress in understanding and sharing these ideas.

options.explain: 正确。consist in 意为“在于、本质上是（= lie in）”，说明数学的本质在于人类大脑中的思想，而非物理组成零件。
错误。consist of 意为“由……组成（强调具体构成成分）”，此处强调哲学意义上的“本质在于”，而非罗列组成部分。
错误。result in 意为“导致（某种结果）”，前后并无因果方向。
错误。persist in 意为“执意坚持做某事”，主语通常是人，且后常接动名词。

source.sentence: In other words, mathematics consists in the ideas living in human brains, with new theorems serving as markers for our progress in understanding and sharing these ideas.
source.title: Surprising AI breakthroughs raise soul-searching questions for mathematicians | Letter

syntax.backbone: mathematics (主) + consists in (谓) + the ideas (宾) + [with new theorems serving as markers ... 伴随状语]

segments.text: with new theorems serving as markers
segments.label: with 独立伴随状语

segments.text: for our progress in understanding and sharing these ideas.
segments.label: 介词后置定语（修饰 markers）

translation.literal: 换句话说，数学存在于活在人类大脑中的思想里，新定理充当我们在理解和分享这些思想方面取得进步的标志。
translation.polished: 换言之，数学的本质在于存在于人类头脑中的思想，而新定理不过是我们在理解与分享这些思想进程中的里程碑。
translation.keyPoint: 务必死记 consist in（在于）vs consist of（由……组成）；with + n. + serving as... 伴随结构译为并列分句“而……充当/不过是……”。

questions.examFocus: 固定搭配 · deprive sb of sth
questions.instruction: 结合后文固定介词 of 与“令小企业和农户失去贷款来源”的语境，选出正确动词：
questions.prompt: The ICBA is warning that could drain $1.3tn (£980bn) of deposits from community banks, ultimately ______ small businesses and farmers of $850bn-worth of loans primarily funded by customers' savings.

options.explain: 错误。derive 意为“源于、获取”，搭配为 derive A from B（接 from 而非 of），是考研高频形近混淆陷阱。
正确。deprive sb of sth 是考研完形铁律搭配，意为“剥夺某人某物”，固定接介词 of（绝不接 from）。
错误。deter sb from doing 意为“威慑/阻止某人做……”，固定搭配介词 from，不接 of。
错误。exempt sb from sth 意为“免除某人（税收/义务）”，接介词 from，且语境为负面损失而非豁免。

source.sentence: The ICBA is warning that could drain $1.3tn (£980bn) of deposits from community banks, ultimately depriving small businesses and farmers of $850bn-worth of loans primarily funded by customers' savings.
source.title: ‘Crypto v community’: 4,000 local US lenders join forces to fight ‘stablecoins’ law

syntax.backbone: The ICBA (主) + is warning (谓) + [(that) that could drain $1.3tn of deposits ... (宾语从句)] + [depriving ... 结果状语]

segments.text: that could drain $1.3tn (£980bn) of deposits from community banks,
segments.label: 省略引导词的宾语从句（that 为指示代词主语）

segments.text: ultimately depriving small businesses and farmers of $850bn-worth of loans
segments.label: 现在分词结果状语
过去分词后置定语（修饰 loans）

translation.literal: 美国独立社区银行协会警告称，此举可能从社区银行抽走 1.3 万亿美元（9800 亿英镑）存款，最终剥夺小企业和农民价值 8500 亿美元、主要由客户储蓄提供资金的贷款。
translation.polished: 美国独立社区银行协会警告，此举可能令社区银行流失 1.3 万亿美元（约 9800 亿英镑）存款，最终导致小企业与农户失去 8500 亿美元原本主要依托储户存款发放的贷款。
translation.keyPoint: 注意 warning that 里的 that 是指示代词作从句主语（引导词 that 已省略）；drain A from B 意为“从 B 抽走/耗尽 A”。

questions.examFocus: 固定搭配 · 书面强否定
questions.instruction: 结合前文“长期充当城镇排污渠、裹挟各类污染物”的语境，选出意为“完全缺乏、毫无……”的固定搭配：
questions.prompt: That flow had long been used as the town flush toilet, carrying off all manner of pollutants, leaving the Goyt system almost ______ life.

options.explain: 错误。be steeped in 意为“沉浸于、充满（历史/文化）”，语义完全相反。
错误。be immune to 意为“对……免疫、不受影响”，与河道毫无生机不符。
正确。be devoid of 是外刊高频书面强否定搭配，意为“完全缺乏、毫无……”，leaving ... almost devoid of life 即“几乎寸草不生/毫无生机”。
错误。be conducive to 意为“有助于、有利于”，与污染破坏生态完全相反。

source.sentence: That flow had long been used as the town flush toilet, carrying off all manner of pollutants, leaving the Goyt system almost devoid of life.
source.title: Country diary: Here for all to see – nature’s remarkable ability to rebound | Mark Cocker

syntax.backbone: That flow (主) + had long been used (谓) + as the town flush toilet (状) + [双现在分词结果状语]

segments.label: 过去完成被动谓语 V

segments.text: carrying off all manner of pollutants,
segments.label: 现在分词伴随状语

segments.text: leaving the Goyt system almost devoid of life.
segments.label: 现在分词结果状语（leave + O + adj.）

translation.literal: 那条水流长期被当作城镇的冲水马桶，带走各种污染物，使戈伊特水系几乎毫无生命。
translation.polished: 这条河道长期被当作整座城镇的排污渠，冲刷着形形色色的污染物，令戈伊特水系几乎沦为死水、生机全无。
translation.keyPoint: all manner of 意为“各式各样的”；连续两个现在分词短语分别表伴随和最终结果，中文按顺承分句处理非常流畅。

questions.examFocus: 固定搭配 · 紧密相连
questions.instruction: 结合“麻雀与人类长久相伴”的语境，选出表示“与……命运紧密相连”的固定搭配：
questions.prompt: But for now there is a glimmer of hope for this little bird, which has lived alongside us for so long and whose fate is so ______ ours.

options.explain: 错误。be incompatible with 意为“与……不相容/冲突”，与 lived alongside us for so long 的相伴语义矛盾。
正确。be bound up with 意为“与……密不可分、息息相关”，外刊人文环保类极高频。
错误。be oblivious to 意为“对……浑然不觉”，不用于形容“命运与我们……”。
错误。be exempt from 意为“免除、豁免于”，与语境不符。

source.sentence: But for now there is a glimmer of hope for this little bird, which has lived alongside us for so long and whose fate is so bound up with ours.
source.title: Signs of a house sparrow comeback in the UK after decades of decline

syntax.backbone: there is (存现主干) + a glimmer of hope (主) + [which ... and whose ... 并列非限制性定语从句]

segments.text: which has lived alongside us for so long
segments.label: 非限制性定语从句 1

segments.text: and whose fate is so bound up with ours.
segments.label: 并列非限制性定语从句 2

translation.literal: 但眼下对这种小鸟而言有一线希望，它与我们并肩生活了如此之久，而且它的命运与我们的如此紧密相连。
translation.polished: 但眼下，这种与人类相伴已久、且命运与我们息息相关的小生灵，终于迎来了一线生机。
translation.keyPoint: a glimmer of hope（一线希望）和 bound up with（息息相关）都可直接迁移到大作文环保/人与自然主题！

questions.examFocus: 固定搭配 · 威慑劝退
questions.instruction: 选出在旅游税争议语境中意为“吓退、使打消念头”的动词：
questions.prompt: While there is little detailed international research on the economic impact of tourist taxes, a study by Bangor University in Wales in 2024 found no evidence to suggest they ______ visitors.

options.explain: 正确。deter（常考 deter sb / deter sb from doing）意为“威慑、劝退、使游客望而却步”，完美呼应旅游业对旅游税赶走游客的担忧。
错误。deprive 必须接双宾结构 deprive sb of sth（剥夺某人某物），不能直接说 deprive visitors。
错误。dispose 表示“处理掉”时须接 of（dispose of），且对象不能是游客。
错误。prevail 为不及物动词，表“战胜/占上风”时须接 over（prevail over）。

source.sentence: While there is little detailed international research on the economic impact of tourist taxes, a study by Bangor University in Wales in 2024 found no evidence to suggest they deter visitors.
source.title: The hospitality industry fears a tourist tax will deter visitors – the evidence says otherwise

syntax.backbone: [While 让步状语从句] + a study (主) + found (谓) + no evidence (宾) + [to suggest ... 不定式定语]

segments.text: While there is little detailed international research on the economic impact of tourist taxes,
segments.label: 让步状语从句（While = 尽管）

segments.text: by Bangor University in Wales in 2024
segments.label: 介词后置定语
不定式后置定语（修饰 evidence，内嵌宾语从句）

translation.literal: 尽管关于旅游税经济影响的详细国际研究很少，但威尔士班戈大学 2024 年的一项研究未发现证据表明它们会吓退游客。
translation.polished: 尽管目前关于旅游税经济影响的详尽国际研究尚不多见，但威尔士班戈大学 2024 年的一项研究并未发现旅游税会劝退游客的证据。
translation.keyPoint: 句首 While 引导让步状语从句（“尽管”）；they 指代前文的 tourist taxes；to suggest... 译作 evidence 的前置定语。

questions.examFocus: 固定搭配 · 冲突不相容
questions.instruction: 结合监管机构负责人因利益回避辞职的语境，选出意为“与……不相容、存在冲突”的固定搭配：
questions.prompt: However, I feel that my current role as chief executive of CQC has become ______ the important conversations happening about care at LTH, including during the time I was chief executive there.

options.explain: 错误。be conducive to 意为“有助于、有利于”，与辞职回避利益冲突的语义相反。
错误。be analogous to 意为“与……类似/可类比”，不能用于解释职位与调查存在冲突。
错误。be integral to 意为“对……不可或缺”，如果不可或缺就不会因此辞职。
正确。be incompatible with 意为“与……不相容、相抵触”，精准表达其现任监管职务与针对前任机构的调查存在冲突。

source.sentence: However, I feel that my current role as chief executive of CQC has become incompatible with the important conversations happening about care at LTH, including during the time I was chief executive there.
source.title: Care Quality Commission chief quits over maternity inquiry into NHS trust he led

syntax.backbone: I (主) + feel (谓) + [that my current role has become incompatible with the important conversations (宾语从句)]

segments.text: that my current role as chief executive of CQC
segments.label: 宾语从句主语

segments.text: including during the time I was chief executive there.
segments.label: 补充范围状语（含省略 when 的定语从句）

translation.literal: 然而，我感到我目前作为护理质量委员会首席执行官的角色，已与正在进行的关于 LTH 护理服务的重要讨论不相容，包括我在那里担任首席执行官期间的情况。
translation.polished: 然而，我认为自己目前担任护理质量委员会首席执行官一职，已与眼下围绕 LTH 医疗照护问题（包括我曾执掌该机构期间）展开的重要质询存在冲突。
translation.keyPoint: conversations 在公关与政经语境中常委婉指“讨论/质询/审查”；注意 incompatible 固定搭配介词 with。

questions.examFocus: 固定搭配 · 四个 + to 易混辨析
questions.instruction: 四个选项全以介词 to 结尾，选出法律条款中“不利于公共利益（not ______ the public good）”最准确的一项：
questions.prompt: The rules include wide discretionary powers for the home secretary to exclude individuals on the basis that their presence is "not ______ the public good because of their conduct, character, associations or other reasons".

options.explain: 错误。be oblivious to 意为“对……浑然不觉”，主语通常是人，不能说“某人的入境对公共利益浑然不觉”。
正确。be conducive to 意为“有助于、有利于”，not conducive to the public good 是英国移民法经典表述（“不利于公共利益”）。
错误。be averse to 意为“厌恶、反对”，主语为人，不用于修饰 presence（入境停留）。
错误。be tantamount to 意为“无异于、等同于”，与“不利于公共利益”逻辑不符。

source.sentence: The rules include wide discretionary powers for the home secretary to exclude individuals on the basis that their presence is "not conducive to the public good because of their conduct, character, associations or other reasons".
source.title: Leftwing US commentator calls decision to ban him from UK ‘Kafkaesque’

syntax.backbone: The rules (主) + include (谓) + wide discretionary powers (宾) + [for ... to exclude 不定式定语] + [on the basis that 同位语从句]

segments.label: 宾语 O（广泛自由裁量权）

segments.text: for the home secretary to exclude individuals
segments.label: 带逻辑主语的不定式定语

segments.text: that their presence is "not conducive to the public good
segments.label: 同位语从句（解释 basis）

segments.text: because of their conduct, character, associations or other reasons".
segments.label: 原因状语

translation.literal: 这些规定赋予内政大臣广泛的自由裁量权，可以基于某人的存在“因其行为、品格、交往或其他原因而不利于公共利益”为由将其拒之门外。
translation.polished: 相关规定赋予内政大臣广泛的自由裁量权：只要有理由认定某人因个人行为、品行、社会关系或其他原因，其入境“不利于公共利益”，即可禁止其入境。
translation.keyPoint: discretionary powers（自由裁量权）、on the basis that（基于……的理由）、the public good（公共利益，good 作名词表“福祉/利益”）。

questions.examFocus: 固定搭配 · 因果方向铁律
questions.instruction: 判断“这种看似矛盾的观点”与“他关于自由的理念”之间的因果方向，选出正确搭配：
questions.prompt: This paradoxical view ______ his idea that we must use our freedom to become ourselves, a concept he develops in his philosophy of existentialism.

options.explain: 错误。result in 表示“前因 → 后果（导致）”，而句中“观点”是果，“理念”是因，方向正好相反！
正确。result from 表示“前果 → 后因（起因于、源于）”，同 stem from / arise from，精准匹配“这一悖论观点源自他的理念”。
错误。contribute to 也表示“导致、促成”（前因后果），与因果方向相反。
错误。consist of 意为“由……组成”，通常接复数构成要素，不用于说明思想渊源。

source.sentence: This paradoxical view results from his idea that we must use our freedom to become ourselves, a concept he develops in his philosophy of existentialism.
source.title: Is it genuine love – or obsessive passion? Kierkegaard, the father of existentialism, had some thoughts

syntax.backbone: This paradoxical view (主) + results from (谓) + his idea (宾) + [that 同位语从句] + [a concept ... 独立同位语]

segments.text: that we must use our freedom to become ourselves,
segments.label: 同位语从句（解释 idea）

segments.text: a concept he develops in his philosophy of existentialism.
segments.label: 独立同位语（含省略 that 的定语从句）

translation.literal: 这种看似矛盾的观点源于他的这样一种理念，即我们必须运用自由去成为自己，这是他在存在主义哲学中发展起来的一个概念。
translation.polished: 这一看似悖论的观点，源于他提出的核心理念——我们必须借由自由成就真正的自我；他在存在主义哲学中进一步阐发了这一概念。
translation.keyPoint: 一箭双雕：巩固 result from（前果后因）与 result in（前因后果）的方向区分，同时练熟“同位语从句 + 独立同位语”的双重解释结构。

questions.examFocus: 非字面词组 · 生义陷阱
questions.instruction: 结合前后转折逻辑，选出最符合外刊语境的动词短语：
questions.prompt: Like many other anthropologists, Sprenger was initially ______ by the term's colonial origins and nebulous usage; yet, when animism started to gain traction in environmental anthropology, he reconsidered his stance.

options.explain: 正确。put off 在考研外刊中除“推迟”外，极常考“使反感、使打消念头/劝退”。后文 yet 引出“他重新考虑了立场”，说明最初因该术语带有殖民色彩而产生排斥。
错误。bear out 意为“证实、支持（理论/假设）”，不能与人作主语构成“被……证实”来解释后文改变立场。
错误。be taken in by 意为“被……欺骗/蒙蔽”，原文强调对术语来源反感而非受骗。
错误。iron out 意为“消除（分歧/小问题）”，宾语通常是 differences/problems，不能用于修饰人。

source.sentence: Like many other anthropologists, Sprenger was initially put off by the term's colonial origins and nebulous usage; yet, when animism started to gain traction in environmental anthropology, he reconsidered his stance.
source.title: My grandmother was a seal

syntax.backbone: 分句1：Sprenger (主) + was put off (谓) ｜ 转折 yet ｜ 分句2：he (主) + reconsidered (谓) + his stance (宾)

segments.text: by the term's colonial origins and nebulous usage;
segments.label: 原因/施动状语

segments.text: when animism started to gain traction in environmental anthropology,
segments.label: 时间状语从句

translation.literal: 像许多其他人类学家一样，斯普伦格最初被这个术语的殖民起源和模糊用法劝退了；然而，当万物有灵论开始在环境人类学中获得关注时，他重新考虑了自己的立场。
translation.polished: 与许多人类学家一样，斯普伦格起初因该术语带有殖民渊源且用法含糊而心生排斥；但随着万物有灵论在环境人类学界逐渐受到重视，他重新审视了自己的立场。
translation.keyPoint: put off 切忌译为“推迟”；gain traction 意为“逐渐获得认可/流行起来”；nebulous 意为“模糊不清的”。

questions.examFocus: 非字面词组 · 独立主格
questions.instruction: 选出最符合句中“协议能否达成取决于某项要求”语境的短语：
questions.prompt: The newly announced measures largely centre on young people and students, with deals ______ an EU demand to reduce tuition fees for EU students at UK universities.

options.explain: 错误。rule out 意为“排除……的可能性”，与英欧重置协议以欧盟诉求为关键前提的语义相反。
正确。hinge on 原意为“靠合页支撑”，引申为“完全取决于、以……为关键前提”，此处在 with 复合结构中作现在分词补足语。
错误。gloss over 意为“掩饰、轻描淡写地带过”，不符合外交谈判条件依存语境。
错误。cut back on 意为“削减（开支/消费）”，搭配对象不能是“协议削减一项要求”。

source.sentence: The newly announced measures largely centre on young people and students, with deals hinging on an EU demand to reduce tuition fees for EU students at UK universities.
source.title: What does the UK-EU ‘reset’ deal mean for immigration and tuition fees?

syntax.backbone: The newly announced measures (主) + centre on (谓) + young people and students (宾) + [with 复合伴随状语]

segments.text: with deals hinging on an EU demand
segments.label: with 独立伴随状语

segments.text: to reduce tuition fees for EU students at UK universities.
segments.label: 不定式后置定语（修饰 demand）

translation.literal: 新公布的措施主要围绕年轻人和学生，伴随着协议取决于欧盟一项降低在英国大学就读的欧盟学生学费的要求。
translation.polished: 新近公布的举措主要聚焦青年与学生群体，而相关协议能否达成，关键取决于欧盟提出的一项要求——降低欧盟学生在英国高校的学费。
translation.keyPoint: with + n. + doing 伴随结构在英一翻译中常拆分为独立分句并用“而……”衔接；to reduce... 作 demand 的同位性后置定语。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 动词高频考点
questions.instruction: 选出在气候峰会谈判语境中意为“着手处理、正面应对”的动词：
questions.prompt: This year, however, countries failed to reach consensus on a final deal, after negotiations broke down over whether to explicitly ______ fossil fuels.

options.explain: 正确。address 在考研外刊中作动词极高频考“着手处理、应对、在协议中明确谈及（难题/议题）”，非“地址”。
错误。afford 生义为“提供、给予”，不与 fossil fuels 构成“明确应对化石燃料问题”的搭配。
错误。arrest 生义为“吸引（注意）/阻止（进程）”，但谈判分歧在于是否在最终文本中正面触及化石燃料议题。
错误。attend 表“处理/照料”时为不及物动词，须加介词 to（attend to）。

source.sentence: This year, however, countries failed to reach consensus on a final deal, after negotiations broke down over whether to explicitly address fossil fuels.
source.title: Cop31: Why the UN climate summit ended in victory for fossil fuel producing nations

syntax.backbone: countries (主) + failed to reach (谓) + consensus (宾) + [after 时间/原因状语从句]

segments.text: after negotiations broke down over whether to explicitly address fossil fuels.
segments.label: 时间状语从句（含 whether 不定式宾语）

translation.literal: 然而，今年各国未能就最终协议达成共识，在谈判因是否明确处理化石燃料而破裂之后。
translation.polished: 然而，由于各方就是否应在文本中明确应对化石燃料问题产生分歧并导致谈判破裂，今年各国未能就最终协议达成共识。
translation.keyPoint: break down 表“（谈判）破裂”；explicitly address 意为“明确应对/正面触及”；中文宜把 after 从句前置以符合因果顺序。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 驳回否定
questions.instruction: 选出意为“驳回、否定、不予采纳”的动词完成句子：
questions.prompt: She noted that treaties could be negotiated within 15 months and ______ the US's proposal of five years to sort out a mandate.

options.explain: 错误。deliver 生义为“发表（演讲）/兑现（承诺）”，与前文主张 15 个月内达成条约、否定美方 5 年方案的逻辑相反。
正确。dismiss 在考研外刊中除“解雇”外，高频考查“驳回、否定、不予考虑（提案/担忧/观点）”。
错误。foster 意为“培养、促进”，与语境中的反对态度冲突。
错误。second 作动词意为“赞成、附议（提议）”，语义完全相反。

source.sentence: She noted that treaties could be negotiated within 15 months and dismissed the US's proposal of five years to sort out a mandate.
source.title: International UN talks on controlling use of autonomous weapons collapse

syntax.backbone: She (主) + noted [that 从句] (谓1+宾1) + and + dismissed (谓2) + the US's proposal (宾2)

segments.text: that treaties could be negotiated within 15 months
segments.label: 宾语从句 O1

segments.text: of five years to sort out a mandate.
segments.label: 后置定语（修饰 proposal）

translation.literal: 她指出条约可以在 15 个月内谈判完成，并且驳回了美国关于用五年时间理清授权的提议。
translation.polished: 她指出，相关条约完全可以在 15 个月内谈成，并当即否决了美方提出的花费五年时间敲定谈判授权的方案。
translation.keyPoint: dismiss 切勿机械译为“解雇”；sort out 意为“理清、解决”；mandate 指“（谈判/官方）授权”。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 致使结构
questions.instruction: 选出能构成“使熟悉的街道变得陌生”这一“动词 + 宾语 + 形容词宾补”结构的动词：
questions.prompt: Inverted views of the city ______ familiar streets strange, while the soundtrack occasionally evokes religious chanting.

options.explain: 错误。weather 作动词生义为“平安度过（危机/风暴）”，不能接形容词宾补 strange。
错误。yield 生义为“出产、产生（结果）/屈服”，不构成 yield + O + adj. 结构。
正确。render 是考研英一超高频书面动词，核心生义为“使成为、致使”，常考结构 render + 宾语 + 形容词（如 render the law obsolete）。
错误。harbor 生义为“心怀（想法/敌意）、窝藏”，不符合语境与句型。

source.sentence: Inverted views of the city render familiar streets strange, while the soundtrack occasionally evokes religious chanting.
source.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother: the sacred and profane collide in this off-kilter hitman drama

syntax.backbone: Inverted views (主) + render (谓) + familiar streets (宾) + strange (宾补) ｜ 对比 while + the soundtrack evokes chanting

segments.label: 形容词宾语补足语 C

translation.literal: 颠倒的城市视角使熟悉的街道变得陌生，而配乐偶尔唤起宗教诵经的感觉。
translation.polished: 颠倒的城市构图让原本熟悉的街道显得陌生疏离，而配乐则不时营造出宛如宗教吟诵般的氛围。
translation.keyPoint: render + O + adj. 译为“使……变得……”；while 此处表伴随对比（“而”）；evoke 意为“唤起、营造出”。

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 主谓隔离长难句
questions.instruction: 区分形近动词词义，选出符合“聊天机器人旨在模拟持续人际关系”语境的一项：
questions.prompt: The GUARD Act, introduced in the US Senate in October 2025 and advanced by the Senate Judiciary Committee in April 2026, would, among other things, prohibit minors from using AI companions – chatbots designed to ______ ongoing personal relationships.

options.explain: 错误。stimulate 意为“刺激、激发（需求/增长）”，AI 伴侣并非去刺激现实人际关系，而是“模拟”人际关系。
正确。simulate 意为“模拟、仿造、假装”，与前文 AI companions / chatbots 精准对应。
错误。accumulate 意为“积累、积聚”，与语境不符。
错误。speculate 意为“推测、投机”，常接 about/on，不能直接接 relationships。

source.sentence: The GUARD Act, introduced in the US Senate in October 2025 and advanced by the Senate Judiciary Committee in April 2026, would, among other things, prohibit minors from using AI companions – chatbots designed to simulate ongoing personal relationships.
source.title: At least it remembers

syntax.backbone: The GUARD Act (主) + would prohibit (谓) + minors (宾) + from using AI companions (补/状)

segments.text: introduced in the US Senate in October 2025 and advanced by the Senate Judiciary Committee in April 2026,
segments.label: 双过去分词非限制性定语
固定搭配宾补（prohibit sb from doing）

segments.text: – chatbots designed to simulate ongoing personal relationships.
segments.label: 破折号同位语（解释 AI companions）

translation.literal: 《GUARD 法案》——于 2025 年 10 月提交美国参议院并于 2026 年 4 月获参议院司法委员会推进——将（除其他条款外）禁止未成年人使用人工智能伴侣，即旨在模拟持续个人关系的聊天机器人。
translation.polished: 《GUARD 法案》于 2025 年 10 月提交美国参议院，并在 2026 年 4 月获参议院司法委员会推进；该法案除其他规定外，拟禁止未成年人使用人工智能伴侣——即那些旨在模拟持续人际关系的聊天机器人。
translation.keyPoint: 典型英一主谓超长隔离结构：先跳过逗号间过去分词短语与插入语 among other things，抓住主干 Act would prohibit minors from using...；Act 译为“法案”，minors 译为“未成年人”。

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 分号同位解释
questions.instruction: 选出意为“暗含、意味着”的形近动词完成句子：
questions.prompt: Importantly, the words conversion and somatisation strongly ______ an active, even deliberate, process; that the patient with a psychosomatic illness is doing something that brings their symptoms about.

options.explain: 错误。comply 意为“遵从、遵守”，且为不及物动词，需搭配 with（comply with rules）。
错误。apply 意为“申请、应用、适用”，无法表达“术语暗含某种含义”。
正确。imply 意为“暗示、暗含、意味着”，也是考研阅读推断题题干最高频词。
错误。supply 意为“供应、提供”，与词汇隐含语义无关。

source.sentence: Importantly, the words conversion and somatisation strongly imply an active, even deliberate, process; that the patient with a psychosomatic illness is doing something that brings their symptoms about.
source.title: How can we explain psychosomatic illnesses?

syntax.backbone: the words conversion and somatisation (主) + imply (谓) + a process (宾) ; [that 同位语从句解释 process]

segments.text: that the patient with a psychosomatic illness is doing something
segments.label: 同位语从句（解释 process）

translation.literal: 重要的是，“转换”和“躯体化”这两个词强烈暗示着一个主动的、甚至刻意的过程；即患有心身疾病的病人正在做某种导致其症状出现的事情。
translation.polished: 更重要的是，“转换”与“躯体化”这两个术语强烈暗含着一种主动、甚至有意为之的过程——仿佛心身疾病患者是在通过某种行为引发了自身症状。
translation.keyPoint: 分号后的 that 从句进一步解释 process，翻译时可用破折号或“即……”自然引出；顺带巩固高频词组 bring about（引起、导致）。

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 替代对比
questions.instruction: 选出表示“前者而非后者”替代对比关系的逻辑短语：
questions.prompt: That's why robot engineers previously focused on creating task-based robots, able to perform a specific function, he adds, ______ trying to emulate everything a human hand can do.

options.explain: 错误。other than 意为“除了（= except）”，考研完形极常将其与 rather than 放在一起做干扰。
正确。rather than 意为“而不是（= instead of）”，连接前后两个平行的动名词短语 creating... 与 trying...，精准构成取舍对比。
错误。owing to 意为“由于、因为”，表示原因，与句中“专注单一功能而非模拟全能人手”的取舍逻辑不符。
错误。insofar as 意为“在……范围内、就……而言”，且须引导完整从句，不能接动名词 trying。

source.sentence: That's why robot engineers previously focused on creating task-based robots, able to perform a specific function, he adds, rather than trying to emulate everything a human hand can do.
source.title: ‘The doom of humanity’: will the quest to make robotic hands render us obsolete?

syntax.backbone: That (主) + is (系) + [why robot engineers focused on creating... rather than trying...] (表语从句)

segments.text: why robot engineers previously focused on creating task-based robots,
segments.label: 表语从句主体

segments.text: able to perform a specific function,
segments.label: 形容词短语后置定语（修饰 robots）

segments.text: trying to emulate everything a human hand can do.
segments.label: 并列对比宾语（含省略 that 的定语从句）

translation.literal: 他补充道，这就是为什么机器人工程师过去专注于制造基于任务的、能够执行特定功能的机器人，而不是试图模仿人手能做的一切。
translation.polished: 他补充道，正因如此，机器人工程师过去往往专注于研发执行单一特定任务的机器人，而非试图去复刻人手所能完成的一切动作。
translation.keyPoint: 插入语 he adds 翻译时宜提至句首；able to perform... 形容词短语后置修饰 robots，译成前置定语更顺畅；emulate 意为“效仿、模拟”。

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 无条件让步
questions.instruction: 结合“甘冒诅咒、行窃绑架”与“必然酿成悲剧”的语义反差，选出恰当的逻辑介词短语：
questions.prompt: The selkie's allure is such that men will risk curses and commit theft and kidnapping to possess her, ______ the certain tragedy that forced marriage augurs.

options.explain: 错误。in line with 意为“与……一致、符合”，与语境中的“不顾必然悲剧”相反。
错误。in light of 意为“鉴于、考虑到”，如果“考虑到必然悲剧”理应放弃，而非执意占有。
错误。on account of 意为“由于、因为”，与让步逻辑冲突。
正确。regardless of 意为“不管、不顾”，同 irrespective of，精准表达“全然不顾强迫婚姻所预示的必然悲剧”。

source.sentence: The selkie's allure is such that men will risk curses and commit theft and kidnapping to possess her, regardless of the certain tragedy that forced marriage augurs.
source.title: My grandmother was a seal

syntax.backbone: The selkie's allure (主) + is (系) + such (表) + [that 结果状语从句] + [regardless of 让步状语]

segments.text: that men will risk curses and commit theft and kidnapping
segments.label: 结果状语从句

translation.literal: 海豹女的魅力如此之大，以至于男人们会冒着遭受诅咒的风险、犯下盗窃和绑架罪来占有她，不管强迫婚姻所预示的必然悲剧。
translation.polished: 海豹女的魅力是如此摄人心魄，以至于男人们为了占有她，宁可甘冒诅咒、行窃掳掠，也全然不顾强迫婚姻注定招致的悲剧。
translation.keyPoint: be such that... 是书面高频结果状语句型（“如此……以至于……”）；certain 作前置定语常译为“必然的”；augur 意为“预示”。

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 主张假设簇
questions.instruction: 阅读外刊原句，选出与高亮动词 posits 语义最贴近的考研阅读同义替换表达：
questions.prompt: The selkie narrative is powerful because it considers the aftermath of things going wrong and posits a world in which violence doesn't mean an end to care.

options.text: puts forward / assumes as a premise
options.explain: 正确。posit 属于考研阅读“主张/假设簇”（contend / maintain / assert / posit），意为“假设、提出（某种构想或前提）”，常被改写为 put forward / propose / assume。
错误。undermine 属于“削弱破坏簇”，与前文 narrative is powerful 的正面论证冲突。
错误。rule out 意为“排除”，语义完全相反。
错误。obscure 属于“模糊难懂簇”，不符合语境。

source.sentence: The selkie narrative is powerful because it considers the aftermath of things going wrong and posits a world in which violence doesn't mean an end to care.
source.title: My grandmother was a seal

syntax.backbone: The selkie narrative (主) + is (系) + powerful (表) + [because 原因状语从句：considers ... and posits a world]

segments.text: because it considers the aftermath of things going wrong
segments.label: 原因状语从句（谓语1）
原因状语从句（并列谓语2）

segments.text: in which violence doesn't mean an end to care.
segments.label: 介词+which 定语从句（修饰 world）

translation.literal: 海豹女叙事之所以有力量，是因为它思考了事情出错后的后果，并假设了一个暴力并不意味着关怀终结的世界。
translation.polished: 海豹女传说之所以富有感染力，在于它直面事态失控后的余波，并构想出这样一个世界：即便遭遇暴力，关怀也并未就此终结。
translation.keyPoint: aftermath 意为“（不幸事件的）余波、后果”；in which 引导定语从句修饰 a world，中文拆成“这样一个世界：……”更自然。

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 至关重要簇
questions.instruction: 阅读外刊原句，选出与高亮词 imperative（此处由形容词转化为名词）在语境中最契合的同义替换：
questions.prompt: They began to move away from the hobbyist drive to build the best thing possible, and towards a business imperative to build something that companies might want to buy in large quantities.

options.explain: 错误。fleeting 属于“短暂瞬逝簇”，与商业量产的刚性驱动力相反。
正确。imperative 属于“至关重要/势在必行簇”（pivotal / paramount / indispensable / imperative）；作名词表示“当务之急、必须完成的刚性目标”。
错误。cautious reservation 意为“谨慎保留”，不符合 towards 后的目标转向。
错误。friction 意为“摩擦冲突”，句中并未提及监管阻力。

source.sentence: They began to move away from the hobbyist drive to build the best thing possible, and towards a business imperative to build something that companies might want to buy in large quantities.
source.title: ‘The doom of humanity’: will the quest to make robotic hands render us obsolete?

syntax.backbone: They (主) + began to move (谓) + [away from the hobbyist drive ... and towards a business imperative ...]

segments.text: to build the best thing possible,
segments.label: 不定式定语（修饰 drive）

segments.text: that companies might want to buy in large quantities.
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 something）

translation.literal: 他们开始远离打造尽可能最好的东西的业余爱好者驱动力，而转向一种商业刚需，即打造企业可能想大量购买的产品。
translation.polished: 他们不再一味追求发烧友式的极致性能，而是转向一种迫切的商业刚需——研发出足以让企业大批量采购的产品。
translation.keyPoint: move away from A and towards B 构成平行对照结构；drive 作名词（熟词生义）指“动力、内驱力”；in large quantities 译为“大批量地”。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 占比表达
questions.instruction: 结合气候峰会“2035 年前使电力占全球终端能源消费 35%”的语境，选出意为“（数量上）占……比例”的动词短语：
questions.prompt: The summit hosts said the target was 35x35 electrification: making electricity ______ 35% of the world's final energy consumption by 2035.

options.explain: 正确。account for 是考研超高频双义词组：①（数量上）占……比例；②解释说明（原因）。此处接 35% 精准表达占比。
错误。allow for 意为“考虑到、留出余地（如误差/延误）”，不能接具体百分比表示“占……份额”。
错误。call for 意为“呼吁、需要”，与前文 making electricity 搭配语义不通。
错误。stand for 意为“代表（缩写/理念）”或“容忍（常用于否定句）”，不表示比例占比。

source.sentence: The summit hosts said the target was 35x35 electrification: making electricity account for 35% of the world's final energy consumption by 2035.
source.title: Cop31: Why the UN climate summit ended in victory for fossil fuel producing nations

syntax.backbone: The summit hosts (主) + said (谓) + [the target was 35x35 electrification] (宾从) : [making electricity account for 35% ... 冒号同位解释]

segments.text: making electricity account for 35% of the world's final energy consumption
segments.label: 冒号解释（动名词短语）

translation.literal: 峰会主办方表示，目标是 35x35 电气化：到 2035 年使电力占世界终端能源消费的 35%。
translation.polished: 峰会主办方指出，其目标是实现“35x35 电气化”——即到 2035 年让电力在全球终端能源消费中的占比达到 35%。
translation.keyPoint: 冒号后的动名词短语具体阐释 35x35 electrification；account for + 百分比在英一图表作文和阅读中均极高频。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 学术实证
questions.instruction: 选出在科研报道中意为“证实、印证（某一观点/假设）”的动词短语：
questions.prompt: His research would ______ the idea, showing that Housing First results in at least 85% of people staying housed 12 or 24 months later, depending on the study.

options.explain: 错误。rule out 意为“排除……的可能性”，与后文“85% 受试者 1–2 年后仍稳定有房可住”的数据支撑方向完全相反。
正确。bear out 是外刊学术报道极高频非字面词组，意为“证实、支持（理论/假设/说法）”，切勿按字面误解为“忍受出来”。
错误。phase out 意为“逐步淘汰、分阶段废除”，不能搭配 the idea 表示研究印证观点。
错误。wear out 意为“磨损殆尽、使筋疲力尽”，与科研验证无关。

source.sentence: His research would bear out the idea, showing that Housing First results in at least 85% of people staying housed 12 or 24 months later, depending on the study.
source.title: ‘Deeply illogical’: this man’s life work could end homelessness – and Trump is doing all he can to stop it

syntax.backbone: His research (主) + would bear out (谓) + the idea (宾) + [showing that ... 分词结果/伴随状语]

segments.text: that Housing First results in at least 85% of people staying housed 12 or 24 months later,
segments.label: 宾语从句（含动名词复合结构）

translation.literal: 他的研究将证实这一想法，表明“住房优先”计划导致至少 85% 的人在 12 或 24 个月后仍保持有房居住，具体取决于哪项研究。
translation.polished: 他的研究印证了这一理念：视具体研究而定，“住房优先”项目能让至少 85% 的受助者在 12 至 24 个月后依然拥有稳定住所。
translation.keyPoint: bear out = confirm / corroborate（证实）；result in + sb doing 构成动名词复合结构；depending on the study 翻译时前置更符合中文习惯。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 科普分解
questions.instruction: 结合反刍动物依靠体表/肠道细菌消化纤维植物并释放甲烷的科普语境，选出意为“分解”的短语：
questions.prompt: Like domesticated cows, wild ruminants such as deer, moose and llamas rely on bacteria to help them ______ the fibrous plants they eat, releasing methane as they go.

options.explain: 错误。build up 意为“逐步建立、积累增强”，与消化分解植物纤维的过程相反。
错误。break out 为不及物短语，意为“（战争/疫情/火灾）突然爆发”，不能带宾语 plants。
正确。break down 在考研科普与政经外刊中一词多考：①（化学/生物）分解；②细分（数据）；③（谈判/系统）破裂故障。
错误。bring down 意为“降低（价格/通胀）、击落、使垮台”，不用于生物消化分解纤维。

source.sentence: Like domesticated cows, wild ruminants such as deer, moose and llamas rely on bacteria to help them break down the fibrous plants they eat, releasing methane as they go.
source.title: Specieswatch: Wild deer release millions of tonnes of methane a year

syntax.backbone: wild ruminants (主) + rely on (谓) + bacteria (宾) + [to help them break down ... 目的状语] + [releasing methane ... 伴随状语]

segments.text: wild ruminants such as deer, moose and llamas
segments.label: 主语 S

segments.text: to help them break down the fibrous plants they eat,
segments.label: 目的状语（含省略 that 的定从）

translation.literal: 像家养牛一样，鹿、驼鹿和美洲驼等野生反刍动物依靠细菌来帮助它们分解所吃的纤维植物，同时在此过程中释放甲烷。
translation.polished: 与家牛类似，鹿、驼鹿和羊驼等野生反刍动物也依赖体内细菌来分解摄入的纤维植物，并在消化过程中释放甲烷。
translation.keyPoint: ruminants（反刍动物）、fibrous（富含纤维的）可借构词法猜义；as they go 此处表“在消化/行进过程中”。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 削减开支
questions.instruction: 结合“长达十余年酝酿的财政危机迫使英格兰五分之二校长压缩特殊教育支持”的语境，选出恰当短语：
questions.prompt: Two-fifths of school leaders in England have been forced to ______ support for children with special educational needs due to a financial crisis "more than a decade in the making", according to a poll.

options.explain: 错误。cash in on 意为“趁机捞一笔、借……牟利”，与财政危机下学校被迫缩减预算相反。
错误。catch up on 意为“补做（落下的工作/睡眠）”，不符合压缩开支语境。
错误。crack down on 意为“严厉打击、取缔（违法行为）”，不能搭配“对特殊教育儿童的支持”。
正确。cut back on（BACK=往回收）意为“削减、缩减（开支/服务/支持）”，是英一经济与民生报道的超高频短语。

source.sentence: Two-fifths of school leaders in England have been forced to cut back on support for children with special educational needs due to a financial crisis "more than a decade in the making", according to a poll.
source.title: Schools forced to cut back on support for Send pupils in England, poll finds

syntax.backbone: Two-fifths of school leaders (主) + have been forced to cut back on (谓) + support (宾) + [due to a financial crisis 原因状语]

segments.text: Two-fifths of school leaders in England
segments.label: 主语 S

segments.text: have been forced to cut back on
segments.label: 被动谓语 V

segments.text: support for children with special educational needs
segments.label: 宾语 O

segments.text: due to a financial crisis "more than a decade in the making",
segments.label: 原因状语（含后置定语）

translation.literal: 根据一项民意调查，由于一场“酝酿了十多年的”财政危机，英格兰五分之二的学校负责人被迫削减对有特殊教育需求儿童的支持。
translation.polished: 一项调查显示，受一场“酝酿逾十年的”财政危机拖累，英格兰五分之二的校长已被迫削减对特殊教育需求儿童的帮扶投入。
translation.keyPoint: more than a decade in the making 是地道外刊表达，译为“酝酿逾十年/积弊十余年”；according to a poll 译为“调查显示”提至句首更流畅。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 纠结沉湎
questions.instruction: 选出意为“一味纠结于、过度沉湎于（国内琐碎议题）”的动词短语：
questions.prompt: In particular, he must avoid the temptation to ______ issues that dominate the Westminster news cycle at the expense of international affairs.

options.explain: 正确。dwell 原意“居住”，dwell on 为非字面词组，意为“老是想着、一味纠结于、详述（常含负面提醒）”。
错误。embark on 意为“开始从事、着手开启（重大改革/新事业）”，不符合 avoid the temptation 的警示语境。
错误。border on 意为“近乎、濒临（如荒谬/疯狂）”，不能用于人作主语去“纠结议题”。
错误。capitalize on 意为“充分利用（优势/机会）”，与后文 at the expense of 警示忽略外交的语境不符。

source.sentence: In particular, he must avoid the temptation to dwell on issues that dominate the Westminster news cycle at the expense of international affairs.
source.title: The Guardian view on priorities for a new prime minister: foreign policy cannot be an afterthought | Editorial

syntax.backbone: he (主) + must avoid (谓) + the temptation (宾) + [to dwell on issues ... 不定式定语]

segments.text: that dominate the Westminster news cycle
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 issues）

segments.text: at the expense of international affairs.
segments.label: 方式/代价状语

translation.literal: 特别是，他必须避免沉湎于主导威斯敏斯特新闻周期的议题而以国际事务为代价的诱惑。
translation.polished: 尤其要警惕的是，他切忌一味纠结于主导英国政坛舆论周期的琐碎议题，而牺牲了对国际事务的关注。
translation.keyPoint: Westminster 指代英国议会与政坛核心圈；at the expense of 译为“以牺牲……为代价”；avoid the temptation to do 活译为“切忌/谨防陷入……的诱惑”。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 负面评估信号
questions.instruction: 选出在政策评估中表示“达不到、未能兑现（经济与气候承诺）”的短语：
questions.prompt: The Commons transport committee said on Thursday that the detailed policy papers laid out by the government showed expansion of the London airport would ______ pledges on the economy and climate.

options.explain: 错误。live up to 意为“不辜负、达到（期待/承诺）”，与议会委员会批评政府未能说服公众的负面基调相反。
正确。fall short of 意为“达不到、未满足（预期/标准/承诺）”，是考研阅读态度题核心负面信号词组。
错误。steer clear of 意为“刻意避开、绕开（风险/麻烦）”，主语应是行动者而非“机场扩建工程”。
错误。run out of 意为“耗尽（资源/时间）”，不能搭配 pledges（承诺）。

source.sentence: The Commons transport committee said on Thursday that the detailed policy papers laid out by the government showed expansion of the London airport would fall short of pledges on the economy and climate.
source.title: Ministers have ‘failed to make the case’ for Heathrow third runway, MPs say

syntax.backbone: The Commons transport committee (主) + said (谓) + [that policy papers showed [expansion would fall short of pledges]] (双层宾语从句)

segments.text: that the detailed policy papers laid out by the government showed
segments.label: 一级宾语从句（含过去分词定语）

segments.text: expansion of the London airport would fall short of pledges on the economy and climate.
segments.label: 二级宾语从句（省略 that）

translation.literal: 下议院交通委员会周四表示，政府公布的详细政策文件显示，伦敦机场的扩建将达不到关于经济和气候的承诺。
translation.polished: 英国下议院交通委员会周四指出，政府提交的详尽政策文件本身就暴露出，伦敦机场扩建项目将无法兑现其在经济与气候方面的承诺。
translation.keyPoint: lay out 意为“详尽列出、公布（政策方案）”；fall short of 与 live up to 是考研阅读高频正反对照考点。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 因果信号
questions.instruction: 选出在学术评论中表示“引发、催生（一系列负面下游后果）”的正式因果短语：
questions.prompt: Data-extractive business models ______ all sorts of negative downstream consequences, such as extremist and misleading content, addictive algorithms and careless product design.

options.explain: 错误。give way to 意为“让位于、向……妥协/被取代”，而非“引发导致”。
错误。give in to 意为“屈服于（压力/诱惑）”，与商业模式引发不良后果的因果关系不符。
正确。give rise to 是正式书面因果短语（= lead to / trigger / breed），高频搭配 debate / consequences / concerns。
错误。give off 意为“散发出（气味/光/热）”，不能接抽象名词 consequences。

source.sentence: Data-extractive business models give rise to all sorts of negative downstream consequences, such as extremist and misleading content, addictive algorithms and careless product design.
source.title: Tech giants are trying to obliterate privacy. Australia has a rare chance to take back part of their power | Lizzie O'Shea

syntax.backbone: Data-extractive business models (主) + give rise to (谓) + all sorts of negative downstream consequences (宾) + [such as ... 举例同位]

segments.text: all sorts of negative downstream consequences,
segments.label: 宾语 O

segments.text: such as extremist and misleading content, addictive algorithms and careless product design.
segments.label: 举例说明（修饰 consequences）

translation.literal: 数据攫取型商业模式引发了各种负面的下游后果，例如极端和误导性内容、成瘾性算法和草率的产品设计。
translation.polished: 以攫取用户数据为核心的商业模式会催生诸多负面连锁后果，包括极端与误导性内容、令人成瘾的算法以及草率失责的产品设计。
translation.keyPoint: data-extractive（数据攫取型的）、downstream consequences（下游/连锁后果）均为科技伦理类外刊地道高频词。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 抑制阻碍
questions.instruction: 选出意为“阻碍、抑制（经济增长与投资）”的动词短语：
questions.prompt: The TUC is urging the new chancellor, John Healey, to order a "root and branch" review of the Office for Budget Responsibility, claiming the forecaster's approach ______ investment.

options.explain: 错误。hold up 侧重“耽搁交通/拖延进度”或“经受检验（hold up under scrutiny）”，搭配 investment 表达“长期抑制投资”不如 hold back 准确。
错误。hold on 为不及物短语，意为“坚持住、别挂电话”，不能直接接宾语 investment。
错误。hold out 意为“坚持抵抗”或“带来（希望 hold out hope）”，与批评预算机构拖累投资的语义相反。
正确。hold back（BACK=往后拉住不放）意为“阻碍、抑制（投资/经济复苏/增长）”，也可表“隐瞒信息”。

source.sentence: The TUC is urging the new chancellor, John Healey, to order a "root and branch" review of the Office for Budget Responsibility, claiming the forecaster's approach holds back investment.
source.title: Union calls for robust review of OBR over fears it holds back economic growth

syntax.backbone: The TUC (主) + is urging (谓) + the new chancellor (宾) + to order a review (宾补) + [claiming ... 分词伴随状语]

segments.text: to order a "root and branch" review of the Office for Budget Responsibility,
segments.label: 宾语补足语 C

segments.text: claiming the forecaster's approach holds back investment.
segments.label: 现在分词伴随状语（含宾语从句）

translation.literal: 英国工会联合会正敦促新任财政大臣约翰·希利下令对预算责任办公室进行一次“彻底的”审查，声称该预测机构的做法阻碍了投资。
translation.polished: 英国工会联合会（TUC）正敦促新任财政大臣约翰·希利下令对预算责任办公室展开“大刀阔斧的”彻底审查，并称该预测机构的评估方式一直制约着投资增长。
translation.keyPoint: root and branch 是英式外刊高频习语，意为“彻底的、追根溯源的”；urge sb to do 与 claiming 分词结构连用是新闻评论常见骨架。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 弥补补偿
questions.instruction: 选出意为“弥补（去年的降水亏空）”的短语，等同于 compensate for：
questions.prompt: Fall 2026's heavy rain and snow may help ______ last year and start to alleviate a long-running drought that has been causing water supply problems across the western U.S. for a quarter century.

options.explain: 正确。make up for 意为“弥补、补偿（亏欠/损失/时间）”，等同于 compensate for，此处指今秋丰沛雨雪有助于弥补去年的缺水。
错误。make out 意为“勉强辨认出、听清、理解”，与降雨弥补干旱亏空无关。
错误。be made up of 须用被动语态表示“由……组成”，且语义与语境不符。
错误。make way for 意为“为……让路、让位”，逻辑不通。

source.sentence: Fall 2026's heavy rain and snow may help make up for last year and start to alleviate a long-running drought that has been causing water supply problems across the western U.S. for a quarter century.
source.title: El Niño created a skiers’ paradise in Chile – now it’s Sierra Nevada and Southern Rockies’ turn

syntax.backbone: Fall 2026's heavy rain and snow (主) + may help make up for (谓1) last year + and + start to alleviate (谓2) a drought

segments.text: that has been causing water supply problems across the western U.S. for a quarter century.
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 drought）

translation.literal: 2026 年秋季的强降雨和降雪可能有助于弥补去年（的亏空），并开始缓解一场四分之一世纪以来一直在美国西部造成供水问题的长期干旱。
translation.polished: 2026 年秋季的丰沛雨雪有望弥补去年的降水缺口，并开始缓解困扰美国西部长达四分之一世纪的持续旱情。
translation.keyPoint: alleviate a drought（缓解旱情）是高频近义词组核心搭配；a quarter century = 25 年；翻译时适当补出“降水缺口”使中文语义完整。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 环保政策高频
questions.instruction: 选出在气候与能源政策报道中最常搭配 fossil fuels 表示“逐步淘汰、分阶段废除”的短语：
questions.prompt: At that conference, nearly 60 countries formed a new "coalition of the willing", separate to Cops, to set out their own national roadmaps to ______ fossil fuels.

options.explain: 错误。carry out 意为“执行、实施（计划/实验）”，不能与 fossil fuels 直接搭配表淘汰。
正确。phase out（OUT=逐步移出）意为“分阶段逐步淘汰、废止”，phase out fossil fuels / subsidies 是考研环保类绝对高频表达。
错误。single out 意为“单独挑出（表扬或批评）”，与路线图淘汰化石燃料无关。
错误。turn out 意为“结果证明是、生产出”，不表示淘汰废止。

source.sentence: At that conference, nearly 60 countries formed a new "coalition of the willing", separate to Cops, to set out their own national roadmaps to phase out fossil fuels.
source.title: Brazil publishes first global ‘roadmap’ for phasing out fossil fuels

syntax.backbone: nearly 60 countries (主) + formed (谓) + a new "coalition of the willing" (宾) + [to set out roadmaps to phase out fossil fuels 目的状语]

segments.label: 形容词后置定语（修饰 coalition）

segments.text: to set out their own national roadmaps
segments.label: 目的状语（不定式）

translation.literal: 在那次会议上，近 60 个国家组成了一个独立于气候大会（Cops）之外的新“意愿联盟”，以制定各自的逐步淘汰化石燃料国家路线图。
translation.polished: 在那次峰会上，近 60 个国家在联合国气候大会（COP）框架之外组建了新的“意愿联盟”，旨在各自制定逐步淘汰化石燃料的国家路线图。
translation.keyPoint: set out（详述/制定）与 phase out（逐步淘汰）双词组联动；separate to Cops 为形容词短语作非限制性后置定语，翻译时前置为“在 COP 框架之外”。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 提出方案
questions.instruction: 选出意为“正式提出（收购/救助方案）”，等同于 propose 的动词短语：
questions.prompt: The controversial offer, reported by the Financial Times, has been ______ by creditors who are hoping to save the struggling utility from being temporarily renationalised.

options.explain: 错误。put off 意为“推迟、使反感”，与债权人主动提出救助报价挽救水务公司的语境相反。
错误。put down 意为“镇压、贬低、记下”，不能与 offer 搭配表“提出方案”。
正确。put forward 意为“提出（提案/报价/论点/候选人）”，是考研阅读和写作中 propose 的高频同义替换。
错误。put aside 意为“搁置一旁、储蓄（钱）”，不符合债权人积极提案的逻辑。

source.sentence: The controversial offer, reported by the Financial Times, has been put forward by creditors who are hoping to save the struggling utility from being temporarily renationalised.
source.title: Thames Water ‘close to deal that would spare it new Ofwat fines until 2030’

syntax.backbone: The controversial offer (主) + has been put forward (谓) + by creditors (状) + [who are hoping ... 定语从句]

segments.label: 过去分词非限制性定语

segments.text: who are hoping to save the struggling utility from being temporarily renationalised.
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 creditors）

translation.literal: 这份由《金融时报》报道的颇具争议的提议，是由希望挽救这家陷入困境的公用事业公司免于被暂时重新国有化的债权人提出的。
translation.polished: 据《金融时报》披露，这项颇具争议的报价由债权人方面提出，意在避免这家陷入困境的公用事业公司被暂时收归国有。
translation.keyPoint: utility 在经济外刊中常考熟词生义“公用事业公司（水/电/燃气）”；save A from doing 译为“避免 A 沦落到……境地”。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 排除可能
questions.instruction: 结合“经过数月审议后决定不申办 2028 年气候峰会、将机会留给其他亚洲国家”的语境，选出意为“排除……可能”的短语：
questions.prompt: China has ______ hosting the Cop33 UN climate summit in 2028 after months of deliberations, leaving the field open for other Asian countries to hold it, the Guardian understands.

options.explain: 错误。carry out 意为“执行、开展”，与后文 leaving the field open for other Asian countries 逻辑相反。
错误。spell out 意为“详细讲清楚”，后常接具体条件或计划，不接动名词 hosting 表示放弃主办。
错误。sort out 意为“理清、解决（问题）”，语义不合。
正确。rule out（OUT=排除在外）意为“排除……的可能性、决定不考虑”，常接名词或动名词（rule out doing）。

source.sentence: China has ruled out hosting the Cop33 UN climate summit in 2028 after months of deliberations, leaving the field open for other Asian countries to hold it, the Guardian understands.
source.title: China rules out hosting Cop33 climate summit in 2028

syntax.backbone: China (主) + has ruled out (谓) + hosting the Cop33 UN climate summit (宾) + [leaving the field open ... 结果状语]

segments.text: hosting the Cop33 UN climate summit in 2028
segments.label: 动名词宾语 O

segments.text: leaving the field open for other Asian countries to hold it,
segments.label: 现在分词结果状语

translation.literal: 《卫报》了解到，经过数月的审议，中国排除了在 2028 年主办第 33 届联合国气候峰会的可能性，从而为其他亚洲国家举办该峰会敞开了大门。
translation.polished: 据《卫报》获悉，历经数月审慎评估后，中国已决定不申办 2028 年 COP33 联合国气候峰会，从而将主办机会留给了其他亚洲国家。
translation.keyPoint: deliberations 指“深思熟虑/反复磋商”；句尾 the Guardian understands 为英媒典型插入语，译至句首“据《卫报》获悉”。

questions.examFocus: 高频非字面词组 · 溯源因果
questions.instruction: 选出意为“源于、由……滋生而来”的不及物动词短语（注意区分及物生义 stem = 遏制）：
questions.prompt: Such gusto ______ a cultural exhaustion with extractionism and with narratives of domination and human exceptionalism that have dogged the culture and geopolitics of the Global North since the 19th century.

options.explain: 正确。stem from 意为“起源于、源于（= arise from / result from）”，专表追溯根源，与后文 cultural exhaustion 严丝合缝。
错误。refrain from 意为“克制不做（某事）”，主语通常为人或机构，不能用于“热情克制疲惫”。
错误。differ from 意为“与……不同”，无法表达“这股热情源于对掠夺主义的文化倦怠”的因果溯源。
错误。exempt 为及物动词，结构应为 exempt A from B（豁免 A 免受 B），不能直接不及物接 from。

source.sentence: Such gusto stems from a cultural exhaustion with extractionism and with narratives of domination and human exceptionalism that have dogged the culture and geopolitics of the Global North since the 19th century.
source.title: My grandmother was a seal

syntax.backbone: Such gusto (主) + stems from (谓) + a cultural exhaustion ... and with narratives ... (宾) + [that have dogged ... 定语从句]

segments.text: a cultural exhaustion with extractionism and with narratives of domination and human exceptionalism
segments.label: 并列介词宾语 O

segments.text: that have dogged the culture and geopolitics of the Global North since the 19th century.
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 narratives）

translation.literal: 这种热情源于对掠夺主义以及对自 19 世纪以来一直困扰着全球北方文化和地缘政治的支配叙事与人类例外论的文化疲惫。
translation.polished: 这股热忱源于人们对资源掠夺主义的深层文化倦怠，也源于对自 19 世纪以来一直困扰“全球北方”文化与地缘政治的支配叙事和人类中心例外论的厌倦。
translation.keyPoint: dog 作动词（熟词生义）意为“长期困扰、纠缠”；Global North 指发达国家阵营；注意把长定语从句拆译以保持中文节奏。

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 省略式让步
questions.instruction: 空格后直接接名词短语 a grubbier version（无谓语动词），选出最地道的高阶让步连词：
questions.prompt: However, reduced to the bare essentials and at its core, Ibac discovered politicians doing politics, ______ a grubbier version.

options.explain: 错误。however 是副词，表“然而”时前后需逗号隔开且引导完整分句，不能直接修饰名词短语 a grubbier version 表“尽管是更肮脏的版本”。
正确。albeit（= although it be）是外刊极高频让步连词，最大语法特征是后面不接完整从句，而直接接名词短语、形容词或介词短语。
错误。whereas 须引导含主谓的完整对比分句，不能单独接一个名词短语。
错误。thereby 是因果副词（意为“从而”），后常接 doing，与让步语义和词性均不符。

source.sentence: However, reduced to the bare essentials and at its core, Ibac discovered politicians doing politics, albeit a grubbier version.
source.title: Victoria’s anti-corruption report reveals more grubby 'whatever it takes' politics than bombshell revelations | Jon Faine

syntax.backbone: Ibac (主) + discovered (谓) + politicians doing politics (宾+宾补) + [albeit a grubbier version 省略让步状语]

segments.text: reduced to the bare essentials and at its core,
segments.label: 过去分词+介词方式状语

translation.literal: 然而，归结到最基本的要素和核心，反腐委员会发现的只是政客们在搞政治，尽管是一个更肮脏的版本。
translation.polished: 然而，剥离表象直击本质，反腐机构查明的无非仍是政客们司空见惯的政治操弄——只不过是手段更为不堪的版本罢了。
translation.keyPoint: reduced to the bare essentials 意为“剥离枝节、归结到最根本之处”；albeit + 名词短语/形容词是英一完形与阅读高频识别点。

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 翻译巨坑短语
questions.instruction: 结合“建立如此深入的特殊地位，使该国几乎等同于欧盟成员国（只差名义）”的语境，选出恰当短语：
questions.prompt: The EU-Canada summit in October should go beyond another list of worthy deliverables and start the process of establishing a special status so deep that the country could eventually become the equivalent of an EU member state in ______ name.

options.explain: 错误。anything but 意为“绝非、根本不”，与前文 special status so deep that... 方向完全相反。
错误。nothing but 意为“仅仅、只不过”，in nothing but name 表示“徒有虚名”，而句意恰恰相反是“虽无其名却有其实”。
正确。in all but name 是经典外刊高阶习语，意为“除名义外实质上已是、几乎就是（= virtually）”。单独用时 all but 意为“几乎/差点就”。
错误。none but 意为“只有（= only）”，通常修饰人作主语，不构成 in none but name。

source.sentence: The EU-Canada summit in October should go beyond another list of worthy deliverables and start the process of establishing a special status so deep that the country could eventually become the equivalent of an EU member state in all but name.
source.title: Canada should become an EU state in all but name. Here’s how to make that a reality | Fabian Zuleeg

syntax.backbone: The EU-Canada summit (主) + should go beyond (谓1) ... and start (谓2) the process ... [so deep that ... 结果状语从句]

segments.text: should go beyond another list of worthy deliverables
segments.label: 并列谓语与宾语1

segments.text: start the process of establishing a special status
segments.label: 并列谓语与宾语2

segments.text: that the country could eventually become the equivalent of an EU member state in all but name.
segments.label: 结果状语从句

translation.literal: 10 月的欧加峰会应当超越又一份有价值的成果清单，启动建立一种如此深入的特殊地位的进程，以至于该国最终可以在除名义外的所有方面成为欧盟成员国的等同体。
translation.polished: 10 月举行的欧加峰会不应止步于又一纸冠冕堂皇的成果清单，而应着手确立一种足够深度的特殊关系，使加拿大最终在除正式名分之外的所有层面实质上等同于欧盟成员国。
translation.keyPoint: 务必牢记三胞胎陷阱：all but = 几乎/除……之外全部（in all but name = 实质上等同）；anything but = 绝非；nothing but = 仅仅。

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 顺承相应副词
questions.instruction: 结合“大脑将实际触感与预期对比，进而照此相应地重新校准力度”的逻辑，选出最准确的副词：
questions.prompt: Your brain compares this information against what it expected to experience, and then recalibrates ______, slowing down the compression force if it feels as if the raspberry is being crushed.

options.explain: 错误。conversely 意为“相反地”，与大脑根据反馈顺势调整动作的顺承关系不符。
错误。nevertheless 意为“尽管如此、然而”，表转折让步而非顺承响应。
错误。otherwise 意为“否则、在其他方面”，无法表达“依据对比结果作相应调整”。
正确。accordingly 是因果顺承副词，强调“照此情况、相应地（采取行动或调整）”，与 recalibrates（重新校准）天衣无缝。

source.sentence: Your brain compares this information against what it expected to experience, and then recalibrates accordingly, slowing down the compression force if it feels as if the raspberry is being crushed.
source.title: ‘The doom of humanity’: will the quest to make robotic hands render us obsolete?

syntax.backbone: Your brain (主) + compares (谓1) this information ... + and + recalibrates accordingly (谓2) + [slowing down ... 分词方式状语]

segments.text: this information against what it expected to experience,
segments.label: 宾语+对比状语
并列谓语 V2（含顺承副词）

segments.text: if it feels as if the raspberry is being crushed.
segments.label: 条件状语从句（含 as if 从句）

translation.literal: 你的大脑会将这一信息与它预期体验到的情况进行比较，然后相应地重新校准，如果感觉覆盆子仿佛正在被压碎，就减缓挤压的力度。
translation.polished: 大脑会将实时感知到的信息与预期体验加以比对，并据此作出相应校准——一旦察觉覆盆子快要被捏碎，便会立刻放缓按压力度。
translation.keyPoint: recalibrate（重新校准）与 accordingly（相应地）是科技科普文经典搭配；as if 后接陈述语气表示极可能发生的现实感。

questions.vocabId: logic::in line with / in accordance with
questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 一致对照短语
questions.instruction: 结合“此次涨薪使亚马逊最低时薪与好市多（Costco）齐平/一致”的商业报道语境，选出恰当短语：
questions.prompt: The wage increase brings Amazon's minimum pay ______ Costco, which raised its lowest starting pay to $20 an hour in 2025, with pay for most workers raised to more than $30 an hour.

options.explain: 正确。bring A in line with B 是外刊经济报道超高频搭配，意为“使 A 与 B 保持一致/看齐/齐平”。
错误。at odds with 意为“与……意见不合、相悖”，与两者同为 20 美元起薪的事实相反。
错误。in light of 意为“鉴于、考虑到”，不构成 bring A in light of B。
错误。on behalf of 意为“代表（某人/某机构）”，不符合薪酬对标语境。

source.sentence: The wage increase brings Amazon's minimum pay in line with Costco, which raised its lowest starting pay to $20 an hour in 2025, with pay for most workers raised to more than $30 an hour.
source.title: Amazon raises starting pay to $20 an hour and adds Whole Foods discount

syntax.backbone: The wage increase (主) + brings (谓) + Amazon's minimum pay (宾) + in line with Costco (补) + [which raised ... 定语从句]

segments.text: which raised its lowest starting pay to $20 an hour in 2025,
segments.label: 非限制性定语从句

segments.text: with pay for most workers raised to more than $30 an hour.
segments.label: with 独立伴随结构

translation.literal: 这次涨薪使亚马逊的最低薪酬与好市多保持一致，好市多在 2025 年将其最低起薪提高到了每小时 20 美元，同时大多数员工的时薪提高到了 30 美元以上。
translation.polished: 此轮加薪使亚马逊的最低起薪与好市多（Costco）看齐——后者早在 2025 年就将最低起薪上调至每小时 20 美元，并将多数员工的时薪提高到 30 美元以上。
translation.keyPoint: bring A in line with B 活译为“使 A 与 B 看齐/接轨”；句尾 with + n. + done 表补充事实，译为并列分句更自然。

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 虚拟语气连词
questions.instruction: 注意后文从句主语是单数 the mother's presence，而谓语却用了动词原形 attract（省略 should 的虚拟语气），据此选出最准确的连词：
questions.prompt: The mother visits only at dusk to suckle her young, the whole process taking a few minutes; otherwise the youngster hunkers down on its own, ______ the mother's presence attract the attention of a passing fox or stoat.

options.explain: 错误。whereas 表对比且用正常陈述语气（若用 whereas，单数主语后须用 attracts），且语义不符。
正确。lest 意为“唯恐、以免（= for fear that）”，语法铁律是其后从句用 (should) + 动词原形虚拟语气，完美解释单数主语后为何用原形 attract！
错误。provided (that) 意为“假如、只要”，不用虚拟动词原形，且与幼兔独自潜伏以防招来天敌的逻辑相反。
错误。now that 意为“既然”，表原因且用陈述语气，语义与语法均错。

source.sentence: The mother visits only at dusk to suckle her young, the whole process taking a few minutes; otherwise the youngster hunkers down on its own, lest the mother's presence attract the attention of a passing fox or stoat.
source.title: Country diary: Spot the young hare – they know how to make it hard | Ed Douglas

syntax.backbone: The mother visits ... ; otherwise the youngster hunkers down (主句2) + [lest the mother's presence attract ... 目的/防备状语从句]

segments.text: The mother visits only at dusk to suckle her young,
segments.label: 分句1（母兔黄昏哺乳）

segments.text: the whole process taking a few minutes;
segments.label: 独立主格结构

segments.text: the youngster hunkers down on its own,
segments.label: 分句2主干

segments.text: the mother's presence attract the attention of a passing fox or stoat.
segments.label: 虚拟语气状语从句（省 should）

translation.literal: 母兔只在黄昏时来给幼崽哺乳，整个过程只花几分钟；其余时间幼崽独自蜷伏着，唯恐母兔的出现引起路过的狐狸或白鼬的注意。
translation.polished: 母兔仅在黄昏现身为幼崽哺乳，全程不过短短数分钟；其余时候，小野兔便独自蛰伏不动，以免母兔的踪迹引来路过的狐狸或白鼬。
translation.keyPoint: 全句一箭双雕考两大语法重器：① 独立主格 the whole process taking...；② lest + 主语 + (should) do 虚拟语气。

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 否定递进
questions.instruction: 紧扣前文否定核心 not building enough submarines for its own fleet（连自身舰队都不够用），选出表“更不用说卖给澳大利亚”的递进短语：
questions.prompt: But the US Congress and navy, on which Australia will depend for its first nuclear-powered submarines – two second-hand Virginia-class attack submarines – continues to signal that it is not building enough submarines for its own fleet, ______ any to sell to Australia.

options.explain: 错误。aside from 意为“除……之外（还/不包括）”，无法体现前文否定基础上的强烈递进语气。
错误。as opposed to 意为“与……相反/而不是”，用于两者对立而非“连 A 都做不到，更别提 B”。
正确。let alone（= much less）意为“更不用说、何况”，典型标志是前文必有否定语义（not building enough...），是考研完形高频常胜项。
错误。by means of 意为“通过……手段”，语义完全不合。

source.sentence: But the US Congress and navy, on which Australia will depend for its first nuclear-powered submarines – two second-hand Virginia-class attack submarines – continues to signal that it is not building enough submarines for its own fleet, let alone any to sell to Australia.
source.title: As Aukus spending and delays blow out, will Australia’s nuclear submarines ever materialise?

syntax.backbone: the US Congress and navy (主) + continues to signal (谓) + [that it is not building enough ... , let alone any to sell ...] (宾从)

segments.text: on which Australia will depend for its first nuclear-powered submarines – two second-hand Virginia-class attack submarines –
segments.label: 介词+which 非限制性定从（含破折号同位语）

segments.text: that it is not building enough submarines for its own fleet,
segments.label: 宾语从句主体

translation.literal: 但澳大利亚首批核动力潜艇——两艘二手弗吉尼亚级攻击潜艇——所依赖的美国国会和海军，持续发出信号称其连为自己舰队建造的潜艇都不够，更不用说有任何多余的可以卖给澳大利亚了。
translation.polished: 然而，澳大利亚首批核动力潜艇（两艘二手弗吉尼亚级攻击型潜艇）所指望的美国国会与海军，仍在不断释放信号：其潜艇产能连满足美军自身舰队都捉襟见肘，更遑论匀出余量出售给澳大利亚。
translation.keyPoint: 主语与谓语间被超长介词+which 定语从句和双破折号同位语隔开，做阅读时先抓主干 Congress and navy continues to signal that...；let alone 承接否定译为“更遑论/更不用说”。

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 正式书面让步
questions.instruction: 结合“尽管财相额外追加了 58 亿英镑，该基金的能力仍勉强赶上通胀”的让步反差，选出正式书面介词：
questions.prompt: The Resolution Foundation argues that, ______ the extra £5.8bn from Reeves, the NWF's capacity has "barely kept pace with inflation".

options.explain: 错误。owing to 意为“由于、因为”，表示因果；若用 owing to，追加巨额资金应当大幅提升而非“勉强追平通胀”。
错误。insofar as 是连词，意为“在……范围内/只要”，后面必须接完整从句，不能接名词短语 the extra £5.8bn。
错误。thereby 是副词（意为“从而”），不能充当介词引导名词短语。
正确。notwithstanding 是正式财经与法律外刊高频让步介词（= despite / in spite of），意为“尽管、虽然”，既可置于名词前也可后置。

source.sentence: The Resolution Foundation argues that, notwithstanding the extra £5.8bn from Reeves, the NWF's capacity has "barely kept pace with inflation".
source.title: The chancellor’s pet PuFins have an important role – but they need more scrutiny | Nils Pratley

syntax.backbone: The Resolution Foundation (主) + argues (谓) + [that , notwithstanding ..., the NWF's capacity has barely kept pace with inflation] (宾从)

segments.label: 让步介词短语（插入从句内）

segments.text: the NWF's capacity has "barely kept pace with inflation".
segments.label: 宾语从句核心

translation.literal: 决议基金会认为，尽管里夫斯额外拨款 58 亿英镑，国家财富基金的能力也只是“勉强跟上通胀”。
translation.polished: 智库“决议基金会”指出，即便加上里夫斯额外追加的 58 亿英镑资金，英国国家财富基金的运力也“勉强只跟得上通胀步伐”。
translation.keyPoint: that 后先插逗号加让步短语是英一长难句高频“断句陷阱”；keep pace with 意为“跟上……步伐”；argue 此处为熟词生义“认为、主张”。

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 因果连带副词
questions.instruction: 选出指代前文“力推自由贸易协定”并表示“由此/因而失去工作”的因果副词：
questions.prompt: Both Bill Clinton and Barack Obama ardently pushed for free-trade agreements, for example, but didn't provide the millions of blue-collar workers who ______ lost their jobs means of getting new ones that paid at least as well.

options.explain: 正确。thereby 意为“从而、由此、因此”，精准回指前文“推行自由贸易协定”，解释数百万蓝领工人“由此失业”的直接因果。
错误。nonetheless 意为“尽管如此、然而”，表转折让步，与政策直接引发失业的因果逻辑相反。
错误。likewise 意为“同样地”，表类比并列而非因果连带。
错误。instead 意为“反而、取而代之”，不能放在 who 与 lost 之间构成“因此失业”的直接因果。

source.sentence: Both Bill Clinton and Barack Obama ardently pushed for free-trade agreements, for example, but didn't provide the millions of blue-collar workers who thereby lost their jobs means of getting new ones that paid at least as well.
source.title: We are finally witnessing the decline of corporate Democrats | Robert Reich

syntax.backbone: Both Bill Clinton and Barack Obama (主) + pushed for (谓1) ... + but + didn't provide (谓2) workers (间宾) + means (直宾)

segments.text: Both Bill Clinton and Barack Obama
segments.label: 并列主语 S

segments.text: means of getting new ones that paid at least as well.
segments.label: 直接宾语（含定语从句）

translation.literal: 例如，比尔·克林顿和巴拉克·奥巴马都热衷于推动自由贸易协定，但没有为因此失去工作的数百万蓝领工人提供找到至少薪资同样高的新工作的途径。
translation.polished: 例如，比尔·克林顿和巴拉克·奥巴马都曾极力力推自由贸易协定，却未能为因此失业的数百万蓝领工人提供谋得同等高薪新职位的出路。
translation.keyPoint: 本句最大阅读障碍是 provide + 超长间接宾语（含 who 定从）+ 直接宾语 means（熟词生义“手段/途径”），需一眼穿透定从找到 provide sb sth 结构！

questions.examFocus: 完形逻辑词 · 鲜明对比连词
questions.instruction: 前后分句将“儿童自由试错”与“成人因顾忌评价而过早否决奇思妙想”形成鲜明对照，选出最精准的对比连词：
questions.prompt: As a result, children experimented more freely and treated mistakes as part of the process ______ adults, wary of judgment, often dismissed unusual ideas before trying them.

options.explain: 错误。unless 意为“除非”，引导条件从句，与儿童和成人的对照逻辑不符。
正确。whereas 是考研完形“常胜对比连词”，专用于连接两个主体/行为形成鲜明反差的分句（“……，而……”）。
错误。therefore 是因果副词，既不表对比，也不能直接无逗号/分号连接两个完整主谓分句。
错误。provided 意为“假如、只要”，表条件而非对照。

source.sentence: As a result, children experimented more freely and treated mistakes as part of the process whereas adults, wary of judgment, often dismissed unusual ideas before trying them.
source.title: Do people become less creative as they get older? Research makes surprising discovery

syntax.backbone: children (主1) + experimented ... and treated ... (谓1) + whereas (对比) + adults (主2) + often dismissed (谓2) + unusual ideas (宾2)

segments.text: experimented more freely and treated mistakes as part of the process
segments.label: 分句1并列谓语与宾补
形容词后置定语（修饰 adults）

translation.literal: 因此，儿童更自由地尝试并把错误视为过程的一部分，而警惕评判的成年人往往在尝试之前就否决了不寻常的想法。
translation.polished: 正因如此，儿童能够更无拘无束地探索试错，把失误视作过程的自然一环；而成年人则因顾忌外界评价，常常还没动手尝试就先否定了奇思妙想。
translation.keyPoint: wary of judgment 形容词短语作主语同位/原因状语（“因顾忌评价”）；顺带复现高频熟词生义 dismiss（否决/不予采纳）。

questions.examFocus: 高频固定搭配 · 类比介词
questions.instruction: 选出与介词 to 搭配、意为“与……类似、可类比于”的学术高频形容词：
questions.prompt: This is ______ focusing on treating a serious symptom in lieu of urgently seeking a remedy for the critical disease that's causing it.

options.explain: 错误。be averse to 意为“厌恶、不愿”，语义与“打比方类比治标不治本”相反。
错误。be oblivious to 意为“对……浑然不觉”，不能用来引出比喻类比。
正确。be analogous to 是科普与社科议论文极高频搭配，意为“与……类似、可与……类比”，常用来引出精妙隐喻。
错误。be immune to 意为“对……免疫、不受影响”，语义不通。

source.sentence: This is analogous to focusing on treating a serious symptom in lieu of urgently seeking a remedy for the critical disease that's causing it.
source.title: AI’s worst disasters will arrive unannounced | Letters

syntax.backbone: This (主) + is (系) + analogous to focusing on treating a serious symptom ... (表语)

segments.text: analogous to focusing on treating a serious symptom
segments.label: 表语 C（be analogous to doing）

segments.text: in lieu of urgently seeking a remedy for the critical disease
segments.label: 替代状语（in lieu of = instead of）

translation.literal: 这类似于专注于治疗一种严重症状，而不是迫切寻找引发该症状的危重疾病的根治办法。
translation.polished: 这种做法无异于只顾着缓解危重症状，却不急于为致病元凶寻找治本之方。
translation.keyPoint: 一句串联三大高阶表达：be analogous to doing（类比于）、in lieu of（= instead of 代替/而不是）、seek a remedy for（寻求……的解决方案）。

questions.examFocus: 高频固定搭配 · 支配受制
questions.instruction: 结合“大型银行在人工智能竞赛中受制于少数硅谷巨头，容易遭遇断网与漫天要价”的语境，选出恰当短语：
questions.prompt: The rating agency Moody's has said the race to adopt AI is putting big banks ______ a small group of Silicon Valley firms, leaving them vulnerable to widespread outages and price gouging by profit-hungry tech bosses.

options.explain: 错误。on the verge of 意为“濒临（崩溃/边缘）”，后接事件或动名词，不接“少数硅谷公司”。
错误。in the wake of 意为“紧随……之后、作为……的后果”，不构成 put banks in the wake of tech firms。
错误。on behalf of 意为“代表”，与大银行沦为科技巨头掣肘对象的警告语义相反。
正确。put/be at the mercy of 意为“任由……摆布、完全受制于”，与后文 vulnerable to outages and price gouging 高度呼应。

source.sentence: The rating agency Moody's has said the race to adopt AI is putting big banks at the mercy of a small group of Silicon Valley firms, leaving them vulnerable to widespread outages and price gouging by profit-hungry tech bosses.
source.title: AI push is putting banks at mercy of tech firms, warns Moody’s

syntax.backbone: The rating agency Moody's (主) + has said (谓) + [the race ... is putting big banks at the mercy of Silicon Valley firms] (宾从) + [leaving them vulnerable ... 结果状语]

segments.text: the race to adopt AI is putting big banks at the mercy of a small group of Silicon Valley firms,
segments.label: 宾语从句（省略 that）

segments.text: leaving them vulnerable to widespread outages and price gouging by profit-hungry tech bosses.
segments.label: 现在分词结果状语

translation.literal: 评级机构穆迪表示，采用人工智能的竞赛正使大银行任由一小群硅谷公司摆布，使其容易受到大范围服务中断和逐利科技老板漫天要价的侵害。
translation.polished: 评级机构穆迪警告称，竞相引入人工智能的热潮正让各大银行沦为少数硅谷巨头的附庸，面临大面积宕机和唯利是图的科技掌门人趁机哄抬价格的风险。
translation.keyPoint: price gouging 是经济外刊高频词，指“趁机哄抬物价/漫天要价”；leave + O + adj.（vulnerable to）为高频结果状语骨架。

questions.examFocus: 高频固定搭配 · 法律税收豁免
questions.instruction: 结合“近 150 国达成跨国企业反避税协议，但美国却得以豁免、惹怒税收透明组织”的语境，选出正确搭配：
questions.prompt: Nearly 150 countries have agreed on a landmark plan to stop large global companies shifting profits to low-tax jurisdictions, but the US will be ______ the deal, angering tax transparency groups.

options.explain: 正确。be exempt from 意为“免除、豁免（税收/协议/规定）”，是考研政经与法律文章极高频搭配。
错误。be derived from 意为“源于、源自”，无法表达美国不受该全球税改协议约束。
错误。be alienated from 意为“与……疏远、格格不入”，不能精准表达法律条文上的“豁免权”。
错误。be deterred from 后多接动名词（被威慑不敢做某事），不能说 be deterred from the deal 表豁免。

source.sentence: Nearly 150 countries have agreed on a landmark plan to stop large global companies shifting profits to low-tax jurisdictions, but the US will be exempt from the deal, angering tax transparency groups.
source.title: US will be exempt from global tax deal targeting profits of large multinationals

syntax.backbone: Nearly 150 countries (主1) + have agreed on (谓1) a plan + but + the US (主2) + will be exempt from (谓2) the deal + [angering ... 结果状语]

segments.text: a landmark plan to stop large global companies shifting profits to low-tax jurisdictions,
segments.label: 宾语 O1（含不定式定语）

translation.literal: 近 150 个国家就一项阻止大型跨国公司将利润转移至低税管辖区的里程碑式计划达成一致，但美国将豁免于该协议，这激怒了税收透明组织。
translation.polished: 近 150 个国家已就一项里程碑式方案达成一致，旨在遏制大型跨国公司向低税率避税地转移利润，但美国却被排除在约束之外，引发税收透明倡议组织的强烈不满。
translation.keyPoint: landmark（里程碑式的）、jurisdiction（司法/税收管辖区）为政经外刊高频词；stop sb (from) doing 为常见动名词结构。

questions.examFocus: 高频固定搭配 · 内在固有介词
questions.instruction: 选出与介词 in 固定搭配、意为“内在固有的（危险）”的学术形容词短语：
questions.prompt: In recent decades it allowed Habermas to develop what amounted to a nascent politics of the human, diagnosing the dangers ______ algorithmic social media's distortion of communication and big tech's hubris.

options.explain: 错误。inferior 固定搭配介词 to 且意为“次于、劣于”，语义与介词均不合。
正确。inherent in 固定接介词 in，常作后置定语（the dangers inherent in... 意为“……中固有的危险”），是考研英一极高频学术搭配。
错误。indifferent 固定接 to 且意为“漠不关心的”，不能用来修饰 dangers。
错误。immune 意为“免受……的”，逻辑与“剖析算法社交媒体内在危险”相反。

source.sentence: In recent decades it allowed Habermas to develop what amounted to a nascent politics of the human, diagnosing the dangers inherent in algorithmic social media's distortion of communication and big tech's hubris.
source.title: The Guardian view on the legacy of Jürgen Habermas: philosophical sustenance for illiberal times | Editorial

syntax.backbone: it (主) + allowed (谓) + Habermas (宾) + to develop [what amounted to ...] (宾补) + [diagnosing the dangers inherent in ... 分词状语]

segments.text: to develop what amounted to a nascent politics of the human,
segments.label: 宾补（含 what 宾语从句）

segments.text: inherent in algorithmic social media's distortion of communication and big tech's hubris.
segments.label: 形容词短语后置定语（修饰 dangers）

translation.literal: 近几十年来，它使哈贝马斯得以发展出相当于一种新兴的人文政治学，诊断算法社交媒体对传播的扭曲以及科技巨头傲慢中所固有的危险。
translation.polished: 近数十年来，这使哈贝马斯得以构建起一套初具雏形的“人文政治学”，敏锐剖析出算法社交媒体扭曲公共交往及科技巨头傲慢自大所固有的深层隐患。
translation.keyPoint: 全句满满英一社科真题味：amount to（相当于）、nascent（初生的/萌芽的）、hubris（傲慢自大）、dangers inherent in...（后置定语前置译）。

questions.examFocus: 高频固定搭配 · 视若无睹
questions.instruction: 结合“对话充满白噪音：有人主导谈话却对对方的回应浑然不觉”的语境，选出最准确的搭配：
questions.prompt: Conversations exhibit white noise when people fail to follow what has just been said: the chat might jump all over the place, or be dominated by a person who seems ______ the other person's responses.

options.explain: 错误。be conducive to 意为“有助于、有利于”，与糟糕对话中的“白噪音”特征相反。
错误。be susceptible to 意为“易受……影响的”，若对对方回应高度敏感，反而是良好倾听而非“白噪音”。
正确。be oblivious to 固定接介词 to，意为“未察觉的、对……浑然不觉/充耳不闻”，精准刻画自说自话的沟通者。
错误。be adjacent to 意为“毗邻、紧挨着”，仅表空间位置。

source.sentence: Conversations exhibit white noise when people fail to follow what has just been said: the chat might jump all over the place, or be dominated by a person who seems oblivious to the other person's responses.
source.title: Want to have a better chat? Scientists say the secret is ‘pink noise’

syntax.backbone: Conversations (主) + exhibit (谓) + white noise (宾) + [when ... 时间状语] : [the chat might jump ... or be dominated by a person [who ...]]

segments.text: when people fail to follow what has just been said:
segments.label: 时间状语从句

segments.text: the chat might jump all over the place, or be dominated by a person
segments.label: 冒号后并列解释分句

segments.text: who seems oblivious to the other person's responses.
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 a person）

translation.literal: 当人们未能跟进刚才所说的内容时，对话就会呈现出白噪音：聊天可能东拉西扯，或者被一个似乎对对方的回应浑然不觉的人所主导。
translation.polished: 当交谈双方未能承接上文内容时，对话便会出现“白噪音”特征：话题可能漫无边际地跳跃，或者全程被一个对他人反馈充耳不闻的人所垄断。
translation.keyPoint: exhibit 在科研文中常译为“呈现出/表现出（特征）”；jump all over the place 活译为“话题东一榔头西一棒子/漫无边际地跳跃”。

questions.examFocus: 高频固定搭配 · 以……为前提
questions.instruction: 选出在政经评论中意为“建立在……基础之上、以……为前提”的高阶搭配：
questions.prompt: Some thinktanks, including the Institute for Fiscal Studies, have criticised how the government's deficit reduction plans seem ______ making unpopular cuts that are unlikely to be enacted at a crucial electoral moment.

options.explain: 错误。inflict A on B 意为“把痛苦/损失强加给 B”，不能说赤字削减计划“强加于不受欢迎的削减”。
错误。be imposed on 意为“被强加于某人/某群体”，后接承受对象而非“实施不受欢迎的预算削减”这一前提条件。
错误。center on 侧重“围绕……话题展开”，不如 predicated on 精准传达“（财务测算）建立在某项极难落地的假设前提之上”。
正确。be predicated on 是经济学人与卫报超高频高阶搭配，意为“基于、以……为假设前提和依据”。

source.sentence: Some thinktanks, including the Institute for Fiscal Studies, have criticised how the government's deficit reduction plans seem predicated on making unpopular cuts that are unlikely to be enacted at a crucial electoral moment.
source.title: Labour’s pledge to level-up minimum wage for under-20s before next election in doubt

syntax.backbone: Some thinktanks (主) + have criticised (谓) + [how the government's deficit reduction plans seem predicated on making cuts [that ...]] (宾从)

segments.text: including the Institute for Fiscal Studies,
segments.label: 举例插入语

segments.text: how the government's deficit reduction plans seem predicated on making unpopular cuts
segments.label: 宾语从句 O

segments.text: that are unlikely to be enacted at a crucial electoral moment.
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 cuts）

translation.literal: 包括财政研究所在内的一些智库批评称，政府的赤字削减计划似乎建立在实施不受欢迎的削减之上，而这些削减在关键的选举时刻不太可能被颁布实施。
translation.polished: 包括英国财政研究所在内的多家智库批评称，政府削减赤字的方案似乎完全押注于推出不得人心的开支削减——而在选战胶着的关键时刻，这类削减几乎不可能真正落地。
translation.keyPoint: enact 意为“颁布、落地实施（法案/政策）”；predicated on 后接动名词 making，译为“建立在……前提之上/押注于”。

questions.examFocus: 高频固定搭配 · 同步伴随
questions.instruction: 结合神经科学扫描发现“短暂走神恰与一股脑脊液流出大脑同时发生”的语境，选出最精准的搭配：
questions.prompt: The brief loss of focus ______ a wave of fluid flowing out of the brain, which returns once attention recovers.

options.explain: 正确。coincide with 意为“与……同时发生、恰逢、一致”，是科研与历史类外刊表达时间或现象同步的核心动词搭配。
错误。comply with 意为“遵守（规则/法规）”，不能用于大脑走神与体液流动的同步关系。
错误。interfere with 意为“妨碍、干扰”，脑成像研究发现两者同步伴生，而非走神去干扰体液流动。
错误。collide with 意为“与……发生物理碰撞/利益冲突”，语义不合。
