source.sentence: The brief loss of focus coincides with a wave of fluid flowing out of the brain, which returns once attention recovers.
source.title: Scans shed light on changes in brain when we zone out while tired

syntax.backbone: The brief loss of focus (主) + coincides with (谓) + a wave of fluid (宾) + [flowing out of the brain 定语] + [which returns ... 定从]

segments.label: 现在分词后置定语（修饰 fluid）
非限制性定语从句（修饰 fluid，含 once 时间从句）

translation.literal: 短暂的注意力丧失与一股流出大脑的液体波同时发生，一旦注意力恢复，这股液体就会回流。
translation.polished: 短暂的走神恰好与一股脑内液体向外流出的波动同步发生，而一旦注意力恢复，这股液体又会随之回流。
translation.keyPoint: once 作连词引导时间状语从句，意为“一旦……”；which 跨过分词短语精准回指 a wave of fluid。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 介词铁律
questions.instruction: 四个动词均含“指责/怪罪”之意，紧扣后文介词 for（... sb for not providing），选出唯一符合搭配铁律的一项：
questions.prompt: In a press conference on Friday, Duffy refused to accept responsibility or apologize for the crisis, ______ Democratic lawmakers and his predecessors for not providing the funding to upgrade outdated systems.

options.explain: 错误。accuse 的介词铁律是 accuse sb OF sth（指控某人某事），绝不接 for！
正确。blame 的介词铁律是 blame sb FOR sth（因某事责怪某人，或 blame sth on sb），与后文 for not providing 完美契合。
错误。charge 表“正式起诉/指控”时固定搭配 WITH（charge sb with fraud），不接 for。
错误。condemn 语气偏公开谴责重大罪行或暴行，在政客甩锅推责（前文 refused to accept responsibility）语境中远不如 blame 自然贴切。

source.sentence: In a press conference on Friday, Duffy refused to accept responsibility or apologize for the crisis, blaming Democratic lawmakers and his predecessors for not providing the funding to upgrade outdated systems.
source.title: FAA chief urges critics to ‘lay off’ Sean Duffy for flight stoppage: ‘Blame me’

syntax.backbone: Duffy (主) + refused to accept ... or apologize ... (谓) + [blaming Democratic lawmakers ... for ... 分词伴随状语]

segments.text: In a press conference on Friday,
segments.label: 地点与时间状语

segments.text: refused to accept responsibility or apologize for the crisis,
segments.label: 谓语与并列宾语

segments.text: blaming Democratic lawmakers and his predecessors
segments.label: 现在分词伴随状语

segments.text: for not providing the funding to upgrade outdated systems.
segments.label: 原因介词短语（blame sb for）

translation.literal: 在周五的新闻发布会上，达菲拒绝承担责任或为这场危机道歉，指责民主党议员及其前任未能提供资金升级过时的系统。
translation.polished: 在周五的新闻发布会上，达菲拒绝为这场危机担责或致歉，反而将矛头指向民主党议员及其前任，指责他们未能拨款升级老旧系统。
translation.keyPoint: 完形必背三剑客介词铁律：blame sb for sth / accuse sb of sth / charge sb with sth；predecessor（前任）反义词 successor（继任者）。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 削弱与消退
questions.instruction: 四个词均含“减少/变弱”之意，选出作及物动词、意为“削弱（舰队规模与战力）”的一项：
questions.prompt: Providing nuclear-powered submarines to Australia would ______ the US navy's own fleet for "many years", a new report for the US Congress has cautioned, questioning whether Australian-flagged vessels could be compelled into service in a conflict with China.

options.explain: 错误。subside 为不及物动词，专指风暴、洪水、剧痛或怒气“平息、消退”，不能带宾语 fleet。
错误。dwindle 为不及物动词，指储备、人数等“逐渐枯竭变少”，不能直接作及物动词带宾语 the US navy's own fleet。
正确。diminish 可作及物动词，意为“削弱、缩减（实力/规模/影响/权利）”，此处精准匹配主语“向澳提供核潜艇”削弱美军自有舰队。
错误。recede 为不及物动词，意为“退去、减弱（如潮水/发际线/希望）”，不能带宾语。

source.sentence: Providing nuclear-powered submarines to Australia would diminish the US navy's own fleet for "many years", a new report for the US Congress has cautioned, questioning whether Australian-flagged vessels could be compelled into service in a conflict with China.
source.title: US warned supplying nuclear-powered submarines to Australia would diminish its own fleet for ‘many years’

syntax.backbone: a new report for the US Congress (主) + has cautioned (谓) + [Providing ... would diminish the US navy's own fleet] (前置宾从) + [questioning whether ... 分词状语]

segments.text: Providing nuclear-powered submarines to Australia would diminish the US navy's own fleet for "many years",
segments.label: 前置宾语从句（动名词作主语）

segments.text: a new report for the US Congress
segments.label: 主句主语 S

segments.text: questioning whether Australian-flagged vessels could be compelled into service in a conflict with China.
segments.label: 现在分词伴随状语（含 whether 宾从）

translation.literal: 一份提交给美国国会的新报告警告称，向澳大利亚提供核动力潜艇将在“许多年”内削弱美国海军自己的舰队，并质疑悬挂澳大利亚国旗的船只是否会在与中国的冲突中被强迫服役。
translation.polished: 一份提交给美国国会的新报告发出警告：向澳大利亚交付核动力潜艇将在“长达数年的时间里”削弱美国海军自身的舰队实力，并质疑一旦发生涉华冲突，澳方舰艇能否被迫投入美军作战序列。
translation.keyPoint: 新闻报道常用“宾语从句前置 + 主句插入”结构；区分及物 diminish 与不及物 dwindle / subside 是完形高频拿分点。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 激励与动机
questions.instruction: 四个名词均与“驱动行为的动因”相关，选出最适合与 federal tax 构成“联邦税收激励/优惠政策”的一项：
questions.prompt: Gordon added that future reforms could make eligibility for federal tax ______, such as negative gearing, conditional on properties meeting minimum standards.

options.explain: 错误。impulse 指突如其来的“一时冲动（如 impulse buying）”或神经电脉冲，不与 tax 搭配。
错误。motive 侧重个人内心深处的“行为动机（如 profit/ulterior motive）”，不指政府出台的税收优惠机制。
错误。stimulus 虽可指宏观财政刺激（fiscal stimulus，常用单数），但具体到“满足最低能效标准才可申请的税收优惠资格”，标准搭配是 tax incentives。
正确。incentive 专指引导市场主体行为的外在经济或政策激励措施，tax / financial incentives 是考研经济类阅读最高频搭配。

source.sentence: Gordon added that future reforms could make eligibility for federal tax incentives, such as negative gearing, conditional on properties meeting minimum standards.
source.title: Landlord inaction on energy upgrades stops renters saving $20bn on power bills in a decade

syntax.backbone: Gordon (主) + added (谓) + [that future reforms could make eligibility ... conditional on properties meeting minimum standards] (宾从)

segments.text: that future reforms could make eligibility for federal tax incentives,
segments.label: 宾语从句主体（make + O）

segments.text: conditional on properties meeting minimum standards.
segments.label: 形容词宾补（make O conditional on...）

translation.literal: 戈登补充说，未来的改革可能会使获得诸如负扣税等联邦税收激励措施的资格，以房产达到最低标准为前提条件。
translation.polished: 戈登补充道，未来的税制改革可将房东申领联邦税收优惠（例如负扣税政策）的资格，与出租房产达到最低节能标准挂钩。
translation.keyPoint: 跨过插入语识别核心句型 make A conditional on B（使 A 以 B 为前提条件）；eligibility 意为“（申领福利/优惠的）资格”。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 常态与规范
questions.instruction: 选出在句中意为“司空见惯的常态”（构成 the new/more the norm）的一项：
questions.prompt: A prime minister remaining in the role out of inertia and lack of options is now more the ______ than that of a viable leader shepherding the country.

options.explain: 正确。norm 意为“社会常态、习以为常的普遍现象”，become / be the norm 是外刊政治与社会评论的超高频表达。
错误。benchmark 指可供行业对标的“优质标杆、衡量基准”，带有正面标杆色彩，不符合对“僵尸政治”的讽刺语境。
错误。criterion（复数 criteria）指“评判筛选的尺度准则”，不能用来形容“首相靠惯性赖在位子上成了普遍常态”。
错误。standard 侧重统一的“质量/道德规格标准”，表“普遍常态”地道表达为 the norm。

source.sentence: A prime minister remaining in the role out of inertia and lack of options is now more the norm than that of a viable leader shepherding the country.
source.title: Zombie politics is the new norm and Starmer’s dying premiership is the latest instalment | Nesrine Malik

syntax.backbone: A prime minister [remaining in the role ...] (主) + is (系) + now more the norm (表) + [than that of a viable leader ... 比较状语]

segments.text: remaining in the role out of inertia and lack of options
segments.label: 现在分词后置定语
表语 C（如今更成常态）

segments.text: than that of a viable leader shepherding the country.
segments.label: 比较状语（含分词后置定语）

translation.literal: 一位出于惯性和缺乏选择而留任的首相，如今比一位有能力引领国家的领导人的景象更成为常态。
translation.polished: 如今，凭着政治惯性与无人替代而勉强留任的首相，比真正堪当大任、引领国家前行的领导人更加司空见惯。
translation.keyPoint: inertia 原为物理“惯性”，引申为政治/体制“惰性”；shepherd 作动词（熟词生义）意为“引导、护航”；out of 表原因（“出于……”）。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 经济前景展望
questions.instruction: 四个名词均含“前景/视角”之意，选出最常与 for the economy / public finances 搭配表示宏观“前景展望”的一项：
questions.prompt: With a tentative pause in the fighting while Trump prepares for crunch midterm elections, the OBR said the ______ for the economy, households and the UK public finances remained highly uncertain.

options.explain: 错误。insight 意为“深刻洞察力（常接 into）”，不用于表示经济未来走势仍高度不确定。
正确。outlook 是财经机构（IMF / OBR / 央行）报告最核心名词，专指对经济、民生或财政的“宏观前景展望”（economic outlook）。
错误。perspective 意为“观察视角、观点角度（from a ... perspective）”，而非“未来前景”。
错误。viewpoint 意为“个人观点、立场”，不能说“英国公共财政的个人观点依然高度不确定”。

source.sentence: With a tentative pause in the fighting while Trump prepares for crunch midterm elections, the OBR said the outlook for the economy, households and the UK public finances remained highly uncertain.
source.title: ‘A pretty grim picture’: outlook for UK living standards slashed despite Healey’s budget

syntax.backbone: [With a tentative pause ... 伴随状语] + the OBR (主) + said (谓) + [the outlook ... remained highly uncertain] (宾从)

segments.text: With a tentative pause in the fighting
segments.label: with 背景伴随状语

segments.text: while Trump prepares for crunch midterm elections,
segments.label: 时间状语从句

segments.text: the outlook for the economy, households and the UK public finances remained highly uncertain.
segments.label: 宾语从句（省略 that）

translation.literal: 随着特朗普准备迎接关键的中期选举，战事出现试探性暂停，英国预算责任办公室表示，经济、家庭和英国公共财政的前景仍然高度不确定。
translation.polished: 尽管在特朗普备战关键中期选举之际战事暂现试探性缓和，英国预算责任办公室仍指出，该国经济、居民家庭及公共财政的前景依然充满高度不确定性。
translation.keyPoint: tentative（试探性的/暂定的）、crunch（关键决胜时刻的，如 crunch talks/elections）均为卫报和经济学人高频词。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 预防与禁止
questions.instruction: 四个词均含“阻止/妨碍”之意，结合宾语 misdiagnosis（医学误诊），选出最准确的一项：
questions.prompt: An alternative to BMI for diagnosing obesity could ______ misdiagnosis in millions of people worldwide, according to doctors who found it more accurately distinguished healthy people from those with harmful excess body fat.

options.explain: 错误。prohibit 意为“通过法律或规章明令禁止（行为）”，诊断指标不能用法律去“明令禁止误诊”。
错误。deter 意为“通过威慑使（人）不敢做某事（deter crime/looters）”，宾语通常是潜在犯罪者而非无意识的医学误诊。
正确。prevent 意为“提前预防、避免（疾病/事故/误诊）发生”，与医疗诊断方案的预防作用完全契合。
错误。hinder 意为“妨碍、拖慢（进程/恢复）”，通常接正面进程，不搭配“妨碍误诊”。

source.sentence: An alternative to BMI for diagnosing obesity could prevent misdiagnosis in millions of people worldwide, according to doctors who found it more accurately distinguished healthy people from those with harmful excess body fat.
source.title: BMI alternative for identifying obesity ‘could prevent misdiagnosis in millions’

syntax.backbone: An alternative to BMI (主) + could prevent (谓) + misdiagnosis (宾) + [according to doctors [who found ...]] (来源与定从)

segments.text: An alternative to BMI for diagnosing obesity
segments.label: 主语 S

segments.text: misdiagnosis in millions of people worldwide,
segments.label: 宾语 O

segments.text: who found it more accurately distinguished healthy people from those with harmful excess body fat.
segments.label: 定语从句（含省略 that 的宾从）

translation.literal: 据医生们称，一种诊断肥胖的 BMI 替代指标可以防止全球数百万人被误诊，他们发现该指标能更准确地区分健康人群和体内有害脂肪过多的人群。
translation.polished: 医生们表示，一种用于诊断肥胖的 BMI 替代方案有望避免全球数百万例误诊；研究发现，该指标能更精准地区分健康人群与体内囤积有害多余脂肪的人群。
translation.keyPoint: alternative to（……的替代方案）；distinguish A from B（把 A 与 B 区分开）；those 指代前文 people，译出具体指代对象。

questions.examFocus: 完形近义辨析 · 触发连锁危机
questions.instruction: 结合主语“战事进一步升级”与宾语“全球经济衰退”，选出意为“瞬间触发、引发连锁危机”的动词：
questions.prompt: A further escalation in the Iran war could ______ a global recession that would affect the UK more than any of the other G7 nations, the International Monetary Fund has warned.

options.explain: 错误。provoke 侧重蓄意“挑衅、激起（强烈情绪或报复，如 provoke outrage/retaliation）”，一般不直接搭配 global recession。
错误。prompt 侧重“促使（某人/机构）及时采取某种行动（prompt sb to do）”，不能说战争升级“促使衰退采取行动”。
错误。tempt 意为“诱惑、吸引某人做某事”，与宏观经济危机无关。
正确。trigger 原意“扳机”，作动词专指像扣动扳机一样“触发（危机/衰退/连锁反应）”，trigger a recession 是外刊经济报道铁搭。

source.sentence: A further escalation in the Iran war could trigger a global recession that would affect the UK more than any of the other G7 nations, the International Monetary Fund has warned.
source.title: Iran war escalation could trigger global recession, IMF warns

syntax.backbone: the International Monetary Fund (主) + has warned (谓) + [A further escalation ... could trigger a global recession [that ...]] (前置宾从)

segments.text: A further escalation in the Iran war could trigger a global recession
segments.label: 前置宾语从句主体

segments.text: that would affect the UK more than any of the other G7 nations,
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 recession）

translation.literal: 国际货币基金组织警告称，伊朗战争的进一步升级可能触发一场全球经济衰退，其对英国的影响将超过其他任何七国集团成员国。
translation.polished: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）警告称，伊朗战事的进一步升级可能引爆全球经济衰退，而英国受到的冲击将超过其余所有七国集团（G7）成员国。
translation.keyPoint: escalation（局势升级/恶化）；比较级 more than any of the other + 复数名词 表达最高级含义（“居 G7 之首/超过其余任何成员”）。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 动词“承担责任”
questions.instruction: 选出在句中意为“承担（大部分照护责任）”、而非“假设”的熟词生义动词：
questions.prompt: While societal gender expectations help explain why daughters often ______ the bulk of caregiving responsibilities, government policies have also determined how much care families must provide.

options.explain: 正确。assume 在考研外刊中极高频考熟词生义“承担（责任/职责/职务）”或“呈现（新面貌）”，assume responsibilities 是标准搭配。
错误。presume 意为“推定、假定（常用于法律无罪推定）”或“冒昧”，不表示“承担责任”。
错误。consume 意为“消耗、消费、吞噬”，不能搭配 caregiving responsibilities。
错误。resume 意为“中断后重新开始”，与社会性别期待导致女儿承担照护重担的语境不符。

source.sentence: While societal gender expectations help explain why daughters often assume the bulk of caregiving responsibilities, government policies have also determined how much care families must provide.
source.title: ‘SNL’ ‘Sister’ sketch nails the failures of US healthcare policy

syntax.backbone: [While societal gender expectations help explain why ... 让步从句] + government policies (主) + have determined (谓) + [how much care families must provide] (宾从)

segments.text: While societal gender expectations help explain
segments.label: 让步状语从句主干

segments.text: why daughters often assume the bulk of caregiving responsibilities,
segments.label: 宾语从句（修饰 explain）

segments.text: how much care families must provide.
segments.label: 主句宾语从句 O

translation.literal: 虽然社会性别期待有助于解释为什么女儿们常常承担大部分照护责任，但政府政策也决定了家庭必须提供多少照护。
translation.polished: 固然社会性别期待在一定程度上解释了为何照护重担大多落在女儿肩上，但政府政策同样决定了家庭究竟不得不扛起多大的照料份额。
translation.keyPoint: While 置于句首引导让步状语从句（“虽然/固然……”）；the bulk of 意为“绝大部分”；assume responsibilities 切勿误译为“假设责任”。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 关注照料
questions.instruction: 紧扣后文介词 to（... to our bodies），选出意为“关注、照料、处理”而非“出席参加”的动词：
questions.prompt: But when these feelings are taken as a potential sign of disease, we tend to become anxious, with consequences for how we experience and ______ to our bodies.

options.explain: 错误。appeal to 意为“吸引、呼吁、诉诸”，与人们焦虑时过度关注自身身体感受的心理机制不符。
正确。attend 作不及物动词接 to（attend to）是考研经典熟词生义，意为“专心关注、照料、处理（身体/事务/病人）”。
错误。adhere to 意为“坚持、遵守（原则/规则）”或“黏附”，不能搭配 our bodies。
错误。amount to 意为“总计、相当于”，语义完全不通。

source.sentence: But when these feelings are taken as a potential sign of disease, we tend to become anxious, with consequences for how we experience and attend to our bodies.
source.title: How can we explain psychosomatic illnesses?

syntax.backbone: [when these feelings are taken as ... 时间从句] + we (主) + tend to become (谓) + anxious (表) + [with consequences for ... 结果伴随状语]

segments.text: when these feelings are taken as a potential sign of disease,
segments.label: 时间状语从句

segments.text: with consequences for how we experience and attend to our bodies.
segments.label: 介词结果状语（含 how 宾从）

translation.literal: 但当这些感觉被视为潜在的疾病征兆时，我们往往会变得焦虑，并对我们如何体验和关注自己的身体产生后果。
translation.polished: 然而，一旦这些身体感受被视作潜藏病兆，人们便容易陷入焦虑，进而影响我们感知和关照自身身体的方式。
translation.keyPoint: take A as B 意为“把 A 当作 B”；attend to 意为“关注/照料”；how 从句作介词 for 的宾语。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 金融账户余额
questions.instruction: 选出在财经报道中意为“（离岸银行账户的）存款余额”、而非“物理平衡”的熟词生义名词：
questions.prompt: HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) data, obtained by the TaxWatch thinktank through freedom of information requests, shows between 2022 and 2024 the value of ______ held offshore in tax havens increased by 10%.

options.explain: 错误。budget 指“预算收支计划”，并非存放在避税天堂账户里的实际“资金余额”。
错误。barrier 意为“障碍、壁垒”，无法与 held offshore in tax havens 搭配。
正确。balance 在经济金融外刊中高频考熟词生义“账户余额、结余资金”（bank/offshore balances），此处复数指各类离岸账户存款余额。
错误。margin 侧重“利润率、保证金或误差幅度”，不指存放在离岸避税地的资金余额。

source.sentence: HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) data, obtained by the TaxWatch thinktank through freedom of information requests, shows between 2022 and 2024 the value of balances held offshore in tax havens increased by 10%.
source.title: UK taxpayers held more than £1tn in offshore tax havens, latest HMRC data shows

syntax.backbone: HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) data (主) + shows (谓) + [between 2022 and 2024 the value of balances ... increased by 10%] (宾从)

segments.text: obtained by the TaxWatch thinktank through freedom of information requests,
segments.label: 过去分词非限制性定语

segments.text: the value of balances held offshore in tax havens increased by 10%.
segments.label: 宾语从句（含过去分词定语）

translation.literal: 税收观察智库通过信息自由申请获得的英国税务海关总署数据显示，2022 年至 2024 年间，存放在避税天堂离岸账户中的余额价值增长了 10%。
translation.polished: 智库 TaxWatch 通过信息公开申请获取的英国税务海关总署（HMRC）数据显示，2022 至 2024 年间，存放在海外避税天堂的离岸账户余额总额增长了 10%。
translation.keyPoint: freedom of information requests（信息公开申请）是英美政经报道常客；主谓之间插入长过去分词定语 obtained by... 时先锁定主干 data shows。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 法律议案/法案
questions.instruction: 选出在法律与政治报道中常与 draft（起草）和 pass（通过）搭配、意为“法案/议案”而非“账单”的名词：
questions.prompt: In 2023, the judiciary drafted a Hijab and Chastity ______ that was later passed but never brought into force.

options.explain: 错误。fine 作名词意为“罚款”，不能被司法机关“起草并通过但从未生效”。
错误。note 指“便条、照会、纸币”，不与 drafted / passed / brought into force 构成标准立法流程搭配。
错误。term 指“条款、任期、术语”，指代单条规定而非整部法律草案。
正确。bill 在政法类外刊中极高频考“法案、法律草案”（draft/pass a bill；法案经签署生效后常成为 Act）。

source.sentence: In 2023, the judiciary drafted a Hijab and Chastity bill that was later passed but never brought into force.
source.title: Catwalks and crackdowns

syntax.backbone: the judiciary (主) + drafted (谓) + a Hijab and Chastity bill (宾) + [that was later passed but never brought into force 定从]

segments.text: that was later passed but never brought into force.
segments.label: 定语从句（并列被动谓语）

translation.literal: 2023 年，司法部门起草了一项《头巾与贞洁法案》，该法案后来获得通过但从未生效实施。
translation.polished: 2023 年，司法机构起草了一项《头巾与贞洁法案》，该法案虽随后获批通过，却始终未能正式付诸实施。
translation.keyPoint: 全句浓缩三大政法高频表达：the judiciary（司法机构）、draft a bill（起草法案）、bring sth into force（使法案正式生效）。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 金额上限/封顶
questions.instruction: 选出在民生财经报道中意为“（补贴/价格的）上限、封顶额度”而非“帽子”的名词：
questions.prompt: While the first element of the payment has had to keep pace with inflation, the £1,000 ______ has risen once in 23 years and has been frozen since 2020, despite rising fees for the elements of a funeral that it covers.

options.explain: 正确。cap 在经济民生报道中极高频考熟词生义“上限、最高限额”（如 price cap / £1,000 cap），作动词表示“给……设上限”。
错误。gap 意为“差距、缺口”，不能说“1000 英镑的缺口自 2020 年起被冻结”。
错误。tap 作名词指“水龙头/轻拍”，作动词生义为“开发利用（tap into）”，均不表额度上限。
错误。lap 指“大腿面/跑道一圈”，与福利封顶限额无关。

source.sentence: While the first element of the payment has had to keep pace with inflation, the £1,000 cap has risen once in 23 years and has been frozen since 2020, despite rising fees for the elements of a funeral that it covers.
source.title: Grieving families getting into debt and doing without memorials due to benefit freezes

syntax.backbone: [While the first element ... 让步从句] + the £1,000 cap (主) + has risen ... and has been frozen ... (并列谓语) + [despite rising fees ... 让步状语]

segments.text: While the first element of the payment has had to keep pace with inflation,
segments.label: 让步对比状语从句

segments.text: has risen once in 23 years and has been frozen since 2020,
segments.label: 并列谓语 V

segments.text: despite rising fees for the elements of a funeral
segments.label: 让步介词短语

translation.literal: 虽然这笔补助的第一部分必须跟上通货膨胀的步伐，但这 1000 英镑的上限在 23 年里只上调过一次，并且自 2020 年以来一直被冻结，尽管它所涵盖的丧葬项目费用不断上涨。
translation.polished: 尽管这项补助的基础部分一直须随通胀同步调整，但其中 1000 英镑的限额在 23 年间仅上调过一次，自 2020 年以来更是始终冻结，丝毫未顾及其所涵盖的各项丧葬费用节节攀升。
translation.keyPoint: 一句双考熟词生义：cap（金额上限）+ cover（补助/保险“涵盖、足以支付”费用）；keep pace with inflation（跟上通胀）。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 政治资本
questions.instruction: 选出与 political 搭配、意为“（政治）资本、威望筹码”而非“首都”的名词：
questions.prompt: In contrast, however, Burnham understands that he has the political ______ to discuss the downsides of Brexit.

options.explain: 错误。political climate 意为“政治风气/气候”，主语通常是社会大环境而非某位政治家“拥有（has）”的个人筹码。
正确。capital 除金融“资本/资金”外，在时政外刊中常考抽象引申义 political / social capital（政治资本/社会资本，即积累的声望与话语权）。
错误。political campaign 意为“政治竞选运动”，语义不如“具备谈论脱欧弊端的政治资本”贴合。
错误。chamber 指“议会大厅/议院”，不能说个人“拥有议院”。

source.sentence: In contrast, however, Burnham understands that he has the political capital to discuss the downsides of Brexit.
source.title: Burnham in Brussels: why party politics still defines the UK’s relationship with Europe

syntax.backbone: Burnham (主) + understands (谓) + [that he has the political capital to discuss the downsides of Brexit] (宾从)

segments.text: that he has the political capital
segments.label: 宾语从句核心

segments.text: to discuss the downsides of Brexit.
segments.label: 不定式定语（修饰 capital）

translation.literal: 然而，相比之下，伯纳姆明白自己拥有讨论英国脱欧弊端的政治资本。
translation.polished: 相比之下，伯纳姆却深知自己具备足以公开探讨英国“脱欧”弊端的政治资本。
translation.keyPoint: political capital（政治资本）和 downside（负面影响/弊端，常与 upside 相对）均为英美时政评论极高频表达。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 创造新词
questions.instruction: 选出在学术史文章中专与 the term 搭配、意为“首创、造出（新术语）”而非“硬币”的动词：
questions.prompt: Edward Tylor, a British anthropologist and a towering figure in the nascent field, ______ the term in his book Primitive Culture (1871).

options.explain: 错误。forge 侧重“锻造、缔结（关系 forge ties）”或“伪造（文件）”，学术上说“首创某术语”的铁搭是 coin a term。
错误。mint 作动词意为“铸造硬币”或“（刚）崭新造就（newly minted）”，极少替代 coin 构成 coin the term。
正确。coin 作动词是考研英一必考熟词生义，专指“创造（新词/新术语）”，coin the term / phrase 在人文社科文章中几乎年年复现。
错误。stamp 意为“盖章、跺脚、打上烙印”，不表示首创新词。

source.sentence: Edward Tylor, a British anthropologist and a towering figure in the nascent field, coined the term in his book Primitive Culture (1871).
source.title: My grandmother was a seal

syntax.backbone: Edward Tylor (主) + coined (谓) + the term (宾) + [in his book Primitive Culture (1871) 地点/出处状语]

segments.text: a British anthropologist and a towering figure in the nascent field,
segments.label: 同位语（介绍主语身份）

translation.literal: 爱德华·泰勒——一位英国人类学家及该新兴领域的泰斗人物——在其 1871 年的著作《原始文化》中创造了这一术语。
translation.polished: 英国人类学家、这一新兴学科的泰斗爱德华·泰勒，在其 1871 年出版的《原始文化》一书中首创了这一术语。
translation.keyPoint: towering figure（泰斗/举足轻重的人物）、nascent field（初兴领域）和 coin the term（首创术语）三连击，极具真题阅读段落首句质感。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 兑现实质成果
questions.instruction: 选出在国际谈判语境中意为“兑现、交出（实质成果）”、而非“派送快递”的动词：
questions.prompt: But Cop31's failure to agree on stronger action on fossil fuels or adequate adaptation finance exposed the widening gap between what vulnerable countries need and what international negotiations are ______.

options.explain: 错误。address 需接具体难题作宾语（address climate change），此处 what 在从句中作宾语指代“实际拿出的成果/承诺兑现”。
错误。harbor 生义为“心怀（怨恨/疑虑）”，不能以“国际谈判”作主语表达产出成果。
错误。register 生义为“（仪表/民调）显示出、记录下”，无法与 vulnerable countries need 构成“需求 vs 供给兑现”的落差。
正确。deliver 在外刊政经文中极高频考熟词生义“兑现（承诺）、交出（实际成果）”，精准对应“脆弱国家所需”与“国际谈判实际产出”之间的鸿沟。

source.sentence: But Cop31's failure to agree on stronger action on fossil fuels or adequate adaptation finance exposed the widening gap between what vulnerable countries need and what international negotiations are delivering.
source.title: Cop31: Why the UN climate summit ended in victory for fossil fuel producing nations

syntax.backbone: Cop31's failure ... (主) + exposed (谓) + the widening gap (宾) + [between [what ... need] and [what ... are delivering] 定语]

segments.text: Cop31's failure to agree on stronger action on fossil fuels or adequate adaptation finance
segments.label: 主语 S（含不定式后置定语）

segments.text: between what vulnerable countries need and what international negotiations are delivering.
segments.label: 后置定语（并列 what 宾语从句）

translation.literal: 但第 31 届气候大会未能就针对化石燃料采取更有力行动或充足的适应气候资金达成一致，暴露了脆弱国家所需与国际谈判实际交付成果之间不断扩大的差距。
translation.polished: 然而，COP31 未能就更有力的化石燃料减排行动或充足的气候适应资金达成协议，暴露出脆弱国家的迫切需求与国际谈判实际所能兑现的成果之间日益扩大的鸿沟。
translation.keyPoint: adaptation finance（气候适应资金）；between what A need and what B are delivering 是极佳的对称结构，翻译时可保留工整对照。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 采用/动用技术
questions.instruction: 选出在科技报道中意为“动用、采用（1 万个 AI 系统）”、而非“雇佣人类员工”的动词：
questions.prompt: But it was solved in a way that struck mathematicians and observers in a way many found strange: a near-trillion-dollar private company spent $15m to ______ 10,000 AI systems to solve the problem.

options.explain: 正确。employ 除“雇佣”外，在科技与学术外刊中极常考熟词生义“采用、运用、动用（方法/策略/技术系统）”，同 utilize。
错误。afford 生义为“提供、给予”，不与 spent $15m to ... 10,000 AI systems 构成“花重金动用系统解题”逻辑。
错误。entertain 生义为“心怀（想法/疑虑）”，不能搭配 10,000 AI systems。
错误。second 作动词生义为“附议、赞成（提议）”，语义不符。

source.sentence: But it was solved in a way that struck mathematicians and observers in a way many found strange: a near-trillion-dollar private company spent $15m to employ 10,000 AI systems to solve the problem.
source.title: Two groups verify mathematician’s claim that Claude helped prove mathematics problem

syntax.backbone: it (主) + was solved (谓) + in a way [that struck ... in a way [many found strange]] : [a private company spent $15m to employ 10,000 AI systems ...]

segments.text: in a way that struck mathematicians and observers in a way many found strange:
segments.label: 方式状语（含双层定语从句）

segments.text: a near-trillion-dollar private company spent $15m to employ 10,000 AI systems to solve the problem.
segments.label: 冒号后具体解释分句

translation.literal: 但它的解决方式让数学家和观察人士感到奇怪：一家市值近万亿美元的私营公司花费 1500 万美元动用 1 万个 AI 系统来解决这个问题。
translation.polished: 然而，这道难题的求解方式却令众多数学家与观察人士颇感诧异：一家市值逼近万亿美元的私营企业豪掷 1500 万美元，动用了一万个 AI 系统来攻克它。
translation.keyPoint: strike sb (as...) 也是熟词生义“给某人留下……印象”；employ + 工具/系统 译为“动用/采用”，切忌直译成“雇佣一万个 AI”。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 激发助长
questions.instruction: 选出在句中作动词、意为“激发、助长（创造力）”而非名词“燃料”的高频词：
questions.prompt: In Jonathan Haidt's The Anxious Generation (2024) and the work that has followed it, a play-based childhood of climbing trees, building forts and suffering the boredom that ______ creativity has been displaced by a smartphone-based one.

options.explain: 错误。check 作动词生义为“遏制、抑制”，与前文作者惋惜“能激发创造力的无聊时光被智能手机取代”的观点完全相反。
正确。fuel 作动词是外刊超高频熟词生义，意为“助长、刺激、为……提供动力（fuel creativity / inflation / debate）”。
错误。tax 作动词生义为“使不堪重负、考验（tax one's patience）”，语义相反。
错误。weather 作动词生义为“平安度过（危机/风暴）”，不能说无聊“度过创造力”。

source.sentence: In Jonathan Haidt's The Anxious Generation (2024) and the work that has followed it, a play-based childhood of climbing trees, building forts and suffering the boredom that fuels creativity has been displaced by a smartphone-based one.
source.title: At least it remembers

syntax.backbone: a play-based childhood [of climbing ..., building ... and suffering the boredom [that fuels creativity]] (主) + has been displaced (谓) + by a smartphone-based one (状)

segments.text: In Jonathan Haidt's The Anxious Generation (2024) and the work that has followed it,
segments.label: 出处范围状语

segments.text: of climbing trees, building forts and suffering the boredom
segments.label: of 并列动名词后置定语
施动者状语（one 指代 childhood）

translation.literal: 在乔纳森·海特的《焦虑的一代》（2024）以及随后的研究中，一个以玩耍为基础——爬树、搭建堡垒和忍受能激发创造力的无聊——的童年，已经被一个以智能手机为基础的童年所取代。
translation.polished: 在乔纳森·海特 2024 年的著作《焦虑的一代》及其后续研究中，那种以自由玩耍为底色——爬树、搭秘密基地、在无聊中孕育创造力——的童年，正被以智能手机为主导的童年全面取代。
translation.keyPoint: displace 意为“取代、使流离失所”；fuel creativity 译为“激发/孕育创造力”；句尾 one 替代前文单数可数名词 childhood。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 介词“鉴于”
questions.instruction: 选出由过去分词转化而来、作介词意为“鉴于、考虑到（自主武器与 AI 的迅猛发展）”的高频词：
questions.prompt: Experts have said that ______ the rapid development of autonomous weapons and AI, the failure to create adequate regulations could have dangerous repercussions.

options.explain: 错误。granted (that) 常作连词引导让步从句（“诚然/就算……”），表“鉴于某已知事实”引出后果时最地道的高频介词是 given。
错误。barring 作介词意为“除非发生、若非（barring accidents）”，与因果推理方向不符。
正确。given 是考研英一完形、阅读与写作“全场景神词”，作介词意为“鉴于、考虑到（= considering）”，后直接接名词短语。
错误。pending 作介词意为“在等待……期间、尚未决定前”，不表示因果前提。

source.sentence: Experts have said that given the rapid development of autonomous weapons and AI, the failure to create adequate regulations could have dangerous repercussions.
source.title: It will soon be too late to regulate use of autonomous weapons, warns Red Cross

syntax.backbone: Experts (主) + have said (谓) + [that [given the rapid development ... 状语], the failure ... could have dangerous repercussions] (宾从)

segments.text: given the rapid development of autonomous weapons and AI,
segments.label: 原因/条件介词短语（鉴于……）

segments.text: the failure to create adequate regulations could have dangerous repercussions.
segments.label: 宾语从句核心

translation.literal: 专家表示，鉴于自主武器和人工智能的快速发展，未能制定充分的监管规定可能会带来危险的后果。
translation.polished: 专家指出，鉴于自主武器与人工智能正迅猛发展，若未能及时出台完备的监管法规，恐将招致危险的连锁恶果。
translation.keyPoint: repercussions（复数常用，意为“严重恶果/深远反响”）是政经科技外刊极高频高阶词；the failure to do 可活译为条件“若未能……”。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · “一大群/许多”
questions.instruction: 选出构成固定量化短语 a ______ of（意为“一大堆、许多[网络与混合攻击]”）、而非“主人/东道主”的名词：
questions.prompt: Over the past decade, there has been interference in its politics, propaganda targeting Estonia's Russian-speaking minority, and a ______ of cyber and hybrid attacks, the most recent of which was an attempted arson attack targeting an Estonian defence company last Saturday.

options.explain: 错误。a panel of 专指“一组专家/陪审团（a panel of judges/experts）”，不能修饰“网络与混合攻击”。
错误。a school of 生义指“一个思想学派”或“一群鱼”，不搭配 cyber attacks。
错误。a flight of 指“一段楼梯/一群飞鸟”或“资本外逃（flight of capital）”，不表“大量攻击”。
正确。a host of 是考研外刊极高频熟词生义量化搭配，意为“一大群、许多、一连串（a host of problems / attacks）”，非“主人”。

source.sentence: Over the past decade, there has been interference in its politics, propaganda targeting Estonia's Russian-speaking minority, and a host of cyber and hybrid attacks, the most recent of which was an attempted arson attack targeting an Estonian defence company last Saturday.
source.title: The Trump-Putin alliance threatens every European country – yet gushing populists still cheer them | Steve Bloomfield

syntax.backbone: there (形式主) + has been (谓) + interference ..., propaganda ..., and a host of cyber and hybrid attacks (并列真主语) + [the most recent of which ... 定从]

segments.text: interference in its politics, propaganda targeting Estonia's Russian-speaking minority, and a host of cyber and hybrid attacks,
segments.label: 三项并列主语 S

segments.text: the most recent of which was an attempted arson attack targeting an Estonian defence company last Saturday.
segments.label: 非限制性定语从句（名词+of+which）

translation.literal: 过去十年来，一直存在对其政治的干涉、针对爱沙尼亚俄语少数群体的宣传，以及一大堆网络和混合攻击，其中最近的一次是上周六针对一家爱沙尼亚国防公司的纵火未遂袭击。
translation.polished: 过去十年间，该国接连遭遇政治干预、面向爱沙尼亚俄语少数群体的舆论宣传，以及层出不穷的网络与混合攻击——最近一起便是上周六针对一家爱沙尼亚防务企业的纵火未遂事件。
translation.keyPoint: the most recent of which 为“局部+of+which”经典非限制性定从，翻译时另起分句译为“其中最近一起便是……”最顺畅。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 日益加剧
questions.instruction: 选出与 pressure 搭配、意为“日益增大的、不断加剧的（压力）”而非“攀登/山峰”的分词形容词：
questions.prompt: Despite ______ pressure, an agreement to discuss an instrument to regulate autonomous weapons over the next two years fell short of the urgent action rights groups said was needed to address the looming threat.

options.explain: 正确。mount 作不及物动词意为“（压力/担忧/债务/批评）逐渐增加、不断加剧”，mounting pressure 是外刊绝对铁搭。
错误。pitch 生义为“推销/游说（pitch an idea）”，不构成 pitching pressure。
错误。stage 生义为“组织举行（抗议/复出 stage a protest）”，不修饰 pressure 表增长。
错误。seal 生义为“敲定（协议 seal a deal）”或“注定（命运）”，语义不合。

source.sentence: Despite mounting pressure, an agreement to discuss an instrument to regulate autonomous weapons over the next two years fell short of the urgent action rights groups said was needed to address the looming threat.
source.title: It will soon be too late to regulate use of autonomous weapons, warns Red Cross

syntax.backbone: [Despite mounting pressure 让步状语] + an agreement [to discuss ...] (主) + fell short of (谓) + the urgent action [rights groups said was needed ...] (宾)

segments.text: an agreement to discuss an instrument to regulate autonomous weapons over the next two years
segments.label: 主语 S（含双层不定式定语）

segments.text: rights groups said was needed to address the looming threat.
segments.label: 定语从句（含插入语 rights groups said）

translation.literal: 尽管压力不断增大，但一项关于在未来两年内讨论监管自主武器法律文书的协议，仍未达到人权组织所说的应对迫在眉睫的威胁所需的紧急行动。
translation.polished: 尽管外界施压日益加剧，各方达成的在未来两年探讨自主武器监管文书的协议，仍远未达到人权组织呼吁的应对这一迫在眉睫威胁所需的紧迫行动力度。
translation.keyPoint: 全句四重考研高频点同框：mounting pressure（日益加剧的压力）、instrument（熟词生义：法律文书/条约）、fall short of（未达）、定从插入语 rights groups said。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 深入反思
questions.instruction: 选出与介词 on 搭配、意为“深思、反思（亲子与 AI 关系）”而非“光学反射”的动词：
questions.prompt: I've thought about it more recently as I have ______ on how children and their parents are relating – increasingly, must relate – to artificial intelligence.

options.explain: 错误。register 不与 on 搭配表“沉思反思”。
正确。reflect on 是考研人文社科文章高频熟词生义，意为“深思、认真反省、仔细思索”，非物理“反射”。
错误。resign oneself to 意为“顺从、听任”，不接 on 表思考。
错误。resolve on 意为“下定决心采取（某行动）”，而非句中“细细思索/反思现状”。

source.sentence: I've thought about it more recently as I have reflected on how children and their parents are relating – increasingly, must relate – to artificial intelligence.
source.title: At least it remembers

syntax.backbone: I (主) + have thought about (谓) + it (宾) + [as I have reflected on [how children and their parents are relating – increasingly, must relate – to AI] 状从]

segments.text: I've thought about it more recently
segments.label: 主句核心

segments.text: how children and their parents are relating
segments.label: 宾语从句主体（介词 on 宾语）
动词 relate 的介词搭配

translation.literal: 最近我对此思考得更多，因为我一直在反思儿童和他们的父母正在如何——而且越来越不得不如何——与人工智能建立关系。
translation.polished: 近来随着我不断深入思考孩子与父母如今如何——且越来越不得不如何——与人工智能相处，我愈发频繁地想到这件事。
translation.keyPoint: relate to（与……相处/建立情感联结）；破折号插入 – increasingly, must relate – 截断了 relate 与介词 to，读长难句须把两端重新拼合。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 形容词“明智稳健”
questions.instruction: 选出作形容词、与 judgment 搭配意为“合理明智、稳健可靠”而非名词“声音”的词：
questions.prompt: The successful Nasa candidate will need to cope with all this, while displaying "technical excellence, ______ judgment, teamwork, and courage".

options.explain: 错误。even 作形容词生义为“平坦的/偶数的/势均力敌的”，不与 judgment 构成标准搭配。
错误。novel 作形容词生义为“新奇的、新颖的”，航天员选拔强调的是沉稳可靠的判断力而非“猎奇判断”。
正确。sound 作形容词是考研极高频熟词生义，意为“合理的、明智的、稳健健全的”（sound judgment / sound advice / financially sound）。
错误。fine 生义为“精细的/罚款”，不如 sound judgment 精准地道。

source.sentence: The successful Nasa candidate will need to cope with all this, while displaying "technical excellence, sound judgment, teamwork, and courage".
source.title: Nasa, please send me to the moon. Science says I’m the perfect crew member | Helen Pilcher

syntax.backbone: The successful Nasa candidate (主) + will need to cope with (谓) + all this (宾) + [while displaying ... 省略状语从句]

segments.text: while displaying "technical excellence, sound judgment, teamwork, and courage".
segments.label: 省略主语的时间/伴随状语

translation.literal: 成功的美国国家航空航天局候选人将需要应对所有这些情况，同时展现出“卓越的技术能力、明智的判断力、团队合作精神和勇气”。
translation.polished: 脱颖而出的 NASA 宇航员人选不仅要能从容应对上述种种考验，还须展现出“精湛的专业素养、审慎明智的判断力、团队协作精神以及过人胆识”。
translation.keyPoint: sound judgment（明智审慎的判断力）、financially sound（财务稳健）均是考研阅读和翻译的必背熟词生义搭配。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 及物动词“遏制止损”
questions.instruction: 注意此处空格后直接带名词宾语 the bleeding（无 from！），选出意为“遏制、止住（股市失血/下滑）”的及物动词：
questions.prompt: After last week's sharp losses in the markets, some stock market authorities are rolling out support measures to ______ the bleeding.

options.explain: 错误。spring 作动词多为不及物（spring up 涌现 / spring from 源于），不能及物搭配 the bleeding 表止血。
错误。court 作动词生义为“招致（危险/灾难）”，与监管部门救市止跌的目标完全相反。
错误。fuel 作动词意为“助长、加剧”，与救市措施想要止住暴跌的意图背道而驰。
正确。stem 一词双考：①不及物 stem from = 源于；②及物 stem sth = 遏制、止住（stem the bleeding / stem the tide / stem the decline），金融报道超高频！

source.sentence: After last week's sharp losses in the markets, some stock market authorities are rolling out support measures to stem the bleeding.
source.title: Tech sell-off eases as stock market support measures are deployed after AI slump – business live

syntax.backbone: [After last week's sharp losses ... 时间状语] + some stock market authorities (主) + are rolling out (谓) + support measures (宾) + [to stem the bleeding 目的状语]

segments.text: After last week's sharp losses in the markets,
segments.label: 时间状语

translation.literal: 在上周市场大幅下跌之后，一些股市监管机构正推出支持措施以止住失血。
translation.polished: 经历上周市场剧烈下挫后，部分股市监管部门正陆续推出托市举措，以期止住跌势。
translation.keyPoint: 务必对比记忆：stem from（不及物：源于）vs. stem + n.（及物：遏制、止住）；roll out 意为“正式推出（新政策/产品）”；measures 为熟词生义“举措”。

questions.examFocus: 熟词生义 · 转化为实际结果
questions.instruction: 选出在医学与经济外刊中极常与 into 连用、意为“最终转化为（更长的生存期）”而非“语言翻译”的动词：
questions.prompt: "We are beginning to see not only a higher percentage of tumour response rates, but also deeper responses and a near doubling in the duration of disease control, which may eventually ______ into longer survival," he said.

options.explain: 正确。translate into 是考研英一超高频熟词生义，意为“转化为、落实为（实际成效/收益/生存期）”，切勿呆板理解成“翻译成”。
错误。transport 意为“物理运输、运送”，不能与 into longer survival 构成临床指标转化关系。
错误。transplant 意为“（器官/植物）移植”，语法和语义均不构成 transplant into longer survival。
错误。transmit 意为“传播（疾病/信号）、传输”，不表示“疗效转化为更长生存期”。

source.sentence: "We are beginning to see not only a higher percentage of tumour response rates, but also deeper responses and a near doubling in the duration of disease control, which may eventually translate into longer survival," he said.

segments.text: not only a higher percentage of tumour response rates, but also deeper responses and a near doubling in the duration of disease control,

segments.label: 非限制性定语从句（指代前面整件事）

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 准入与评估
questions.instruction: 区分形近词词义，选出与 market 搭配构成“市场准入资格”的一项：
questions.prompt: The fundamental problems of being outside the EU were laid bare: you have to pay for market ______ and align with rules on which you no longer have a vote.

options.explain: 错误。assess 是动词，意为“评估、评定”，词性与词义均无法填入名词位 pay for market ______。
正确。access 作名词意为“进入途径、使用权、准入资格”，market access（市场准入）是国际贸易外刊核心术语。
错误。asset 意为“资产、宝贵财富”，脱欧后英国付费换取的是欧盟单一市场的“准入权”而非买下资产。
错误。excess 意为“过量、过度（in excess of）”，与市场准入毫无关系。

source.sentence: The fundamental problems of being outside the EU were laid bare: you have to pay for market access and align with rules on which you no longer have a vote.
source.title: Undoing Brexit is the right thing to attempt – but sadly, I can't see Andy Burnham pulling it off | Paul Taylor

segments.label: 主语 S

segments.label: 冒号后解释分句

segments.text: on which you no longer have a vote.

translation.polished: 置身欧盟之外的症结由此暴露无遗：既要花钱买“市场准入券”，又不得不遵循自己再无投票权的规则。
translation.keyPoint: lay bare 意为“彻底揭露/暴露无遗”；align with（与……看齐/遵循一致）；on which 还原为 have a vote on rules（对规则享有投票权）。

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 采纳与适应
questions.instruction: 区分 adapt / adopt / adept，选出符合“气候峰会第一天短短几小时内就正式通过了会议议程”语境的一项：
questions.prompt: In fact, the conference agenda was ______ within a few hours on day one, as country parties found nothing objectionable.

options.explain: 错误。adapt 意为“适应（adapt to）”或“改编（小说/剧本）”，会议议程未被修改而是顺利“通过/采纳”。
错误。adept 是形容词，意为“熟练的、擅长的（be adept at）”，不能作被动语态谓语。
正确。adopt 除“收养”外，在政经会议与科研文中最高频考“正式采纳、表决通过（议程/法案/方案）”。
错误。adore 意为“热爱、崇拜”，显然不用于正式国际会议通过议程。

source.sentence: In fact, the conference agenda was adopted within a few hours on day one, as country parties found nothing objectionable.
source.title: Cop31: Why the UN climate summit ended in victory for fossil fuel producing nations

syntax.backbone: the conference agenda (主) + was adopted (谓) + [within a few hours on day one 时间状语] + [as country parties found nothing objectionable 原因从句]

segments.label: 时间状语

segments.text: as country parties found nothing objectionable.
segments.label: 原因状语从句

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 确保与保险
questions.instruction: 区分 assure / ensure / insure，选出后接宾语从句表示“确保（电气化能够减少对化石燃料的依赖）”的一项：
questions.prompt: With the negotiations ending without agreement, there was no collective commitment to ______ electrification would reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

options.explain: 错误。assure 意为“向某人保证以使其安心”，语法铁律是宾语必须是人（assure sb that...），不能直接接从句。
错误。insure 专指商业“投保、买保险（insure against risk）”，与确保减排目标落地无关。
错误。reassure 同样以“人”作宾语，意为“安抚某人消除疑虑”，不能直接接 that 从句。
正确。ensure 意为“确保、保证（某种结果发生）”，后可直接接名词或 (that) 从句，与 commitment to doing 完美衔接。

source.sentence: With the negotiations ending without agreement, there was no collective commitment to ensuring electrification would reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
source.title: Cop31: Why the UN climate summit ended in victory for fossil fuel producing nations

segments.text: With the negotiations ending without agreement,
segments.label: with 独立伴随状语
介词 to + 动名词（commitment to doing）

segments.text: electrification would reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
segments.label: 宾语从句（省略 that）

translation.literal: 随着谈判在未达成协议的情况下结束，各方没有作出集体承诺来确保电气化将减少对化石燃料的依赖。
translation.polished: 随着谈判无果而终，各国未能就“确保电气化切实降低对化石燃料的依赖”达成任何集体承诺。
translation.keyPoint: 牢记 commitment to 中的 to 是介词，须接动名词 ensuring；assure sb（向人保证）vs. ensure sth/that（确保结果）vs. insure（买保险）是完形常青考点。

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 贴合顺应与确认
questions.instruction: 区分 confirm 与 conform，结合神经触觉感受器检测“手指如何伸展并贴合包裹物体轮廓”的语境，选出正确动词：
questions.prompt: As well as the nerve endings, the hand has specialist receptors that can tell our brains about very fine details: different corpuscle cells to detect vibration, roughness and smoothness, or how our fingers and hands stretch and ______ around objects.

options.explain: 正确。conform 原意“顺应、符合、随形贴合”（con- 共同 + form 形状），此处精准描绘人手抓握时手指自然贴合物体外形。
错误。confirm 意为“确认、证实（消息/预约）”，不能与 around objects 搭配表示手指变形贴合。
错误。confront 意为“直面、对抗（难题/对手）”，与手部抓握生理机制无关。
错误。confine 意为“限制、禁锢（be confined to）”，语义完全不同。

source.sentence: As well as the nerve endings, the hand has specialist receptors that can tell our brains about very fine details: different corpuscle cells to detect vibration, roughness and smoothness, or how our fingers and hands stretch and conform around objects.
source.title: ‘The doom of humanity’: will the quest to make robotic hands render us obsolete?

syntax.backbone: [As well as the nerve endings 状语] + the hand (主) + has (谓) + specialist receptors (宾) + [that can tell ... 定从] : [different corpuscle cells ... 冒号解释]

segments.text: As well as the nerve endings,
segments.label: 递进附加状语

segments.text: that can tell our brains about very fine details:
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 receptors）

segments.text: different corpuscle cells to detect vibration, roughness and smoothness,
segments.label: 冒号同位列举1

segments.text: or how our fingers and hands stretch and conform around objects.
segments.label: 并列宾语从句（detect 宾语2）

translation.literal: 除了神经末梢之外，手部还有专门的感受器，可以告诉我们的大脑非常精细的细节：不同的小体细胞用来探测振动、粗糙度和光滑度，或者我们的手指和手掌如何围绕物体伸展并贴合。
translation.polished: 除了神经末梢，人手还分布着专门的感受器，能向大脑传递极其精细的触觉细节：各类小体细胞可感知振动、粗糙与光滑质感，还能察觉手指与手掌在抓握物体时如何伸展并随形贴合。
translation.keyPoint: 拆词根永不混：con-firm（共同弄牢固 -> 确认证实）vs. con-form（共同成型 -> 遵循/随形贴合）；fine 此处为熟词生义“精细的”。

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 意识/良心/尽责
questions.instruction: 区分 conscience / conscious / conscientious，选出与 decision 搭配意为“深思熟虑、有意识作出的（决定）”的一项：
questions.prompt: We have already released AI at scale, without making a ______ decision about how it should be used by those among the most vulnerable in our culture.

options.explain: 错误。conscience 是名词，意为“良心、道德心（guilty conscience）”，不能作形容词修饰 decision。
正确。conscious 是形容词，意为“有意识的、清醒自觉的”，make a conscious decision（作出清醒自觉的决定）是议论文超高频搭配。
错误。conscientious 意为“勤勉认真的、尽职尽责的（常修饰人或工作态度）”，一般不说 make a conscientious decision。
错误。consensus 是名词，意为“共识（reach a consensus）”，词性与语法不合。

source.sentence: We have already released AI at scale, without making a conscious decision about how it should be used by those among the most vulnerable in our culture.
source.title: At least it remembers

syntax.backbone: We (主) + have released (谓) + AI (宾) + at scale (状) + [without making a conscious decision about [how it should be used ...] 方式状语]

segments.text: about how it should be used by those among the most vulnerable in our culture.
segments.label: 介词宾语从句（修饰 decision）

translation.literal: 我们已经大规模发布了人工智能，却没有就我们文化中最脆弱的群体应该如何使用它作出有意识的决定。
translation.polished: 我们尚未就社会中最脆弱的人群究竟应如何使用人工智能作出清醒审慎的抉择，便已将其大规模推向市场。
translation.keyPoint: at scale（大规模地）；those among the most vulnerable 意为“最易受伤害的那部分群体（指儿童等弱势者）”；中文先译 without 条件更有警醒感。

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 源自与剥夺
questions.instruction: 区分 derive 与 deprive，紧扣后文介词 from（be ______ directly from Freud），选出意为“源于、衍生自”的一项：
questions.prompt: The terms "conversion" and "somatisation" are ______ directly from Freud and still pop up frequently in the literature.

options.explain: 错误。deprive 意为“剥夺”，固定搭配介词 of（be deprived of rights），绝不接 from！
错误。devise 意为“设计、发明（策略/仪器）”，施动者须用 by（devised by Freud），不接 from。
正确。derive 意为“起源于、源自、从中获取”，固定搭配介词 from（be derived from），与“术语直接源自弗洛伊德”严丝合缝。
错误。divert 意为“转移方向、使分心（divert attention/funds from）”，不符合词源溯源语境。

source.sentence: The terms "conversion" and "somatisation" are derived directly from Freud and still pop up frequently in the literature.
source.title: How can we explain psychosomatic illnesses?

syntax.backbone: The terms "conversion" and "somatisation" (主) + are derived (谓1) directly from Freud + and + still pop up (谓2) frequently in the literature

segments.text: still pop up frequently in the literature.
segments.label: 并列谓语2（含状语）

translation.literal: “转换”和“躯体化”这两个术语直接源自弗洛伊德，并且至今仍频繁出现在学术文献中。
translation.polished: “转换”与“躯体化”这两个术语直接脱胎于弗洛伊德学说，至今仍在各类学术文献中频频现身。
translation.keyPoint: 一箭双雕记考法：① derive from（源自）vs. deprive of（剥夺）；② the literature 在科研外刊中常考熟词生义“学术文献”，非“文学作品”。

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 延伸适用范围
questions.instruction: 区分 expand / expend / extend，结合法律语境“将强制控制罪的适用范围延伸至私人亲密关系之外”，选出最精准的一项：
questions.prompt: In February, the Home Office said it did not intend to ______ the coercive control offence under the Serious Crime Act 2015 beyond personally connected relationships.

options.explain: 错误。expend 意为“耗费、支出（精力/时间/资金 expend energy/resources）”，不能搭配 legal offence。
错误。expand 侧重体积、规模或业务“膨胀扩大”，而在法律条款中表示将某项罪名或权利的“效力边界延伸超越（beyond）”现有范畴，标准动词是 extend。
错误。exceed 意为“超过（数量/限度）”，不构成 exceed an offence beyond... 结构。
正确。extend 意为“延伸、扩大（期限/适用范围/法律效力）”，extend A beyond B（把 A 的覆盖范围延伸到 B 之外）是法律新闻铁搭。

source.sentence: In February, the Home Office said it did not intend to extend the coercive control offence under the Serious Crime Act 2015 beyond personally connected relationships.
source.title: There’s probably a cult hiding in plain sight on your high street. At last, Britain is confronting the problem | Rachael Reign

segments.text: it did not intend to extend the coercive control offence
segments.label: 宾语从句核心（省略 that）
介词后置定语（修饰 offence）

translation.polished: 今年 2 月，英国内政部表示，无意将《2015 年严重犯罪法》中“强制控制罪”的适用边界扩大到私人亲密关系之外。
translation.keyPoint: 词根区分 ex-tend（拉长延伸范围/期限）、ex-pand（铺开膨胀体积）、ex-pend（花钱耗费精力）；Home Office 为英国内政部，Act 为“法案”。

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 摩擦阻力与微小部分
questions.instruction: 区分 fraction 与 friction，结合“AI 随时秒回免除了孩子等待迟来或落空回应时的微妙摩擦/阻力”语境，选出正确名词：
questions.prompt: But I do notice that he is being relieved of something: the subtle ______ of having to wait for the answer that comes late or not at all.

options.explain: 正确。friction 意为“摩擦、阻力、磕绊”，在科技与心理外刊中极高频用来指现实人际互动中不可避免的延迟、拒绝与磨合（the subtle friction）。
错误。fraction 意为“极小一部分、分数（a fraction of the cost）”，与等待回应带来的心理磨合阻力无关。
错误。fracture 意为“骨折、彻底断裂”，语义过重，不与 subtle 搭配形容日常等待的小磕绊。
错误。fiction 意为“虚构小说、捏造之事”，语义不合。

source.sentence: But I do notice that he is being relieved of something: the subtle friction of having to wait for the answer that comes late or not at all.
source.title: At least it remembers

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 想象力三兄弟
questions.instruction: 区分 imaginative / imaginary / imaginable，选出修饰儿童“富有想象力的角色扮演游戏”的准确形容词：
questions.prompt: The Soviet psychologist Lev Vygotsky saw ______ play as a way for children to move beyond the immediate world, trying out unfamiliar roles and exploring possibilities that ordinary life has not yet offered them.

options.explain: 错误。imaginary 意为“虚构的、假想中不存在的（如 an imaginary friend/enemy）”，而儿童的游戏本身是真实开展的，不是虚构不存在的。
正确。imaginative 意为“富于想象力的、充满创意的”，imaginative play 是发展心理学标准术语（“想象性游戏”）。
错误。imaginable 意为“可想象得到的”，常置名词后与最高级连用（the worst outcome imaginable）。
错误。imitative 意为“单纯模仿的、缺乏原创性的”，与后文 exploring possibilities that ordinary life has not yet offered 强调创造探索相反。

source.sentence: The Soviet psychologist Lev Vygotsky saw imaginative play as a way for children to move beyond the immediate world, trying out unfamiliar roles and exploring possibilities that ordinary life has not yet offered them.
source.title: At least it remembers

segments.text: as a way for children to move beyond the immediate world,
segments.label: 介词短语宾补（see A as B）

segments.text: trying out unfamiliar roles and exploring possibilities
segments.label: 并列现在分词方式状语

segments.text: that ordinary life has not yet offered them.
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 possibilities）

translation.literal: 苏联心理学家列夫·维果茨基将富于想象力的游戏视为儿童超越眼前世界的一种方式，借此尝试不熟悉的角色并探索日常生活尚未向他们提供的可能性。
translation.polished: 苏联心理学家列夫·维果茨基认为，想象性游戏是儿童突破眼前现实世界的重要途径——他们借此演练陌生角色，探索日常生活尚未赋予他们的种种可能。
translation.keyPoint: 考研必分三兄弟：imaginative（有想象力的）、imaginary（虚构不存在的）、imaginable（想象得到的）；the immediate world 译为“眼前直接所处的现实世界”。

questions.examFocus: 形近词辨析 · 敏感与明智
questions.instruction: 区分 sensible / sensitive / sensory，紧扣后文介词 to（be ______ to the fact that...），选出意为“对某事实高度敏感/察觉顾及”的一项：
questions.prompt: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch appears to be ______ to the fact that many people disapprove of how the Tories handled Brexit – whether they voted Remain or Leave.

options.explain: 错误。sensible 意为“明智的、通情达理的（a sensible decision）”，不构成 be sensible to the fact 表示“对公众不满高度敏感”。
错误。sensory 意为“感官的、感觉神经的（sensory overload）”，用于生理感官而非政治敏感度。
正确。be sensitive to 意为“对……敏感的、体察顾及到……的”，此处指保守党党魁敏锐意识到选民对其脱欧处理方式的不满。
错误。sensational 意为“轰动性的、哗众取宠的”，语义完全不合。

source.sentence: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch appears to be sensitive to the fact that many people disapprove of how the Tories handled Brexit – whether they voted Remain or Leave.
source.title: Burnham in Brussels: why party politics still defines the UK’s relationship with Europe

syntax.backbone: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch (主) + appears to be (系) + sensitive to the fact (表) + [that many people disapprove ... 同位语从句]

segments.text: that many people disapprove of how the Tories handled Brexit
segments.label: 同位语从句（解释 fact，含 how 宾从）

segments.text: – whether they voted Remain or Leave.
segments.label: 破折号让步补充状语

translation.literal: 保守党领袖凯米·巴德诺赫似乎对这样一个事实很敏感，即许多人——无论他们当年投票留欧还是脱欧——都不赞成保守党处理脱欧的方式。
translation.polished: 保守党党魁凯米·巴德诺赫似乎敏锐地意识到，无论选民当年投票支持留欧还是脱欧，许多人如今都对保守党处理“脱欧”的方式颇为不满。

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 缓解减排簇
questions.instruction: 阅读外刊原句，选出与高亮动词 mitigate 在气候政策语境中最契合的考研阅读同义替换：
questions.prompt: Small island states and least developed countries like the Marshall Islands have emitted very little in the past and have very little to mitigate today.

options.explain: 错误。exacerbate / intensify 意为“加剧、恶化”，与小岛国碳排极低、可供削减缓解的排放微乎其微语义相反。
错误。fabricate / distort 意为“捏造、歪曲”，与气候减排语境无关。
错误。overlook / dismiss 意为“忽视、驳回”，并非 mitigate 的词义。

options.text: alleviate or reduce the severity of
options.explain: 正确。mitigate 属于考研阅读“缓解遏制簇”（alleviate / mitigate / ease / curb），在气候语境中专指“减缓排放、减轻危害程度”。

source.sentence: Small island states and least developed countries like the Marshall Islands have emitted very little in the past and have very little to mitigate today.
source.title: Cop31: Why the UN climate summit ended in victory for fossil fuel producing nations

segments.label: 并列主语 S

segments.text: have emitted very little in the past
segments.label: 并列谓语与宾状1

segments.text: have very little to mitigate today.
segments.label: 并列谓语与宾语2（不定式定语）

translation.literal: 像马绍尔群岛这样的小岛屿国家和最不发达国家在过去排放得很少，今天也几乎没有什么可减缓的。
translation.polished: 像马绍尔群岛这样的小岛屿国家及最不发达国家历史上温室气体排放极少，如今也几乎没有什么可削减的减排空间。
translation.keyPoint: 气候外刊两大核心词对：mitigate（减缓/减排，治本）vs. adapt（适应气候变化，应对后果）；have very little to do 译为“几乎没有……的余地”。

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 难以捉摸簇
questions.instruction: 阅读天文科普原句，选出与高亮形容词 elusive（形容极难观测的水星）最贴切的同义替换：
questions.prompt: Binoculars may help locate the elusive world, but be sure to stop using them before sunrise to avoid accidentally looking towards the dangerously bright sun.

options.text: hard to find or capture clearly
options.explain: 正确。elusive 属于“模糊难捉摸簇”（ambiguous / obscure / vague / elusive），核心义为“难以寻觅的、难以捉摸的、难以企及的”。
错误。abundant / easily accessible 意为“充裕且唾手可得的”，与需要双筒望远镜才勉强能定位的水星特征相反。
错误。hostile / destructive 意为“敌对的、破坏性的”，原句中危险的是阳光而非水星本身。
错误。permanent 意为“永久不变的”，与 elusive 词义无关。

source.sentence: Binoculars may help locate the elusive world, but be sure to stop using them before sunrise to avoid accidentally looking towards the dangerously bright sun.
source.title: Starwatch: a rare chance to observe elusive Mercury

syntax.backbone: Binoculars (主1) + may help locate (谓1) the elusive world + but + (you) be sure to stop using them (祈使分句2) + [to avoid ... 目的状语]

segments.text: be sure to stop using them before sunrise
segments.label: 分句2祈使句

segments.text: to avoid accidentally looking towards the dangerously bright sun.
segments.label: 目的状语（avoid doing）

translation.literal: 双筒望远镜可能有助于定位这颗难以寻觅的星球，但务必在日出前停止使用它们，以避免意外望向极其刺眼的太阳。
translation.polished: 借助双筒望远镜或许能帮人捕捉到这颗行踪难觅的行星，但务必在日出前放下望远镜，以免不慎直视耀眼灼目的太阳。
translation.keyPoint: world 在天文科普中常代指“行星/天体”（此处指水星 Mercury）；avoid 后固定接动名词 looking。

questions.vocabId: paraphrase::comply with / conform to / adhere to / abide by
questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 遵守遵从簇
questions.instruction: 阅读外刊原句，选出与高亮短语 comply with 语义最一致的考研阅读同义替换：
questions.prompt: They do not readily comply with repeated demands from their own government and US authorities to move their operations out of China.

options.explain: 错误。challenge / overturn 意为“挑战、推翻”，与 comply with 词义相反。
正确。comply with 属于“遵守遵从簇”（comply with / conform to / adhere to / abide by），意为“遵从、服从（要求/法规/指令）”。
错误。speculate about 意为“推测”，不表示服从要求。
错误。subsidize / finance 意为“补贴、资助”，与语境无关。

source.sentence: They do not readily comply with repeated demands from their own government and US authorities to move their operations out of China.
source.title: Why Taiwanese firms are reluctant to leave China, even as tensions rise

syntax.backbone: They (主) + do not readily comply with (谓) + repeated demands (宾) + [from their own government ... 定语] + [to move their operations out of China 同位定语]

segments.text: from their own government and US authorities
segments.label: 介词后置定语

segments.text: to move their operations out of China.

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 违抗抵制簇
questions.instruction: 阅读社科外刊原句，选出与高亮动词 defy 语义最贴近的同义替换：
questions.prompt: Instead, they defy its authority by living in a way it cannot accommodate, but which is quieter and slower and much harder to suppress.

options.explain: 错误。endorse / legitimize 意为“公开支持、赋予合法性”，与后文 harder to suppress（更难镇压）逻辑相反。
错误。emulate / imitate 意为“效仿、模仿”，不符合对抗权威的语境。
正确。defy 属于“违抗抵制簇”（defy / withstand / resist / counteract），核心义为“公然违抗、抵制、不服从（权威/常规）”。
错误。consolidate / reinforce 意为“巩固、强化”，语义完全相反。

source.sentence: Instead, they defy its authority by living in a way it cannot accommodate, but which is quieter and slower and much harder to suppress.
source.title: Catwalks and crackdowns

syntax.backbone: they (主) + defy (谓) + its authority (宾) + [by living in a way [it cannot accommodate], [but which is quieter ... and much harder to suppress] 方式状语]

segments.label: 定语从句1（省略 that，修饰 way）

segments.text: but which is quieter and slower and much harder to suppress.
segments.label: 并列定语从句2（修饰 way）

translation.literal: 相反，他们通过以一种它无法容纳、但更安静、更缓慢且更难镇压的方式生活，来违抗它的权威。
translation.polished: 相反，他们以一种令当局无从吸纳、却更为悄然平缓且极难弹压的生活方式，悄然抗衡着它的权威。
translation.keyPoint: 同一先行词 a way 后接两个由 but 连接的并列定语从句（前省 that，后用 which）；顺带复现高频熟词生义 accommodate（容纳/顺应）。

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 缩减缩小簇
questions.instruction: 阅读医学试验报道原句，选出与高亮动词 shrink 在临床疗效语境中最契合的同义替换：
questions.prompt: During the trial, tumours stopped growing in 90% of patients, just over 60% of patients had their tumours shrink or disappear, and for about 8% of patients tumours became undetectable on CT scans.

options.explain: 错误。proliferate 意为“急剧增殖、激增”，与肿瘤停止生长或消失（disappear）的积极疗效相反。
错误。stabilize 仅对应前文 stopped growing，而 shrink 进一步表示肿瘤体积实际“缩小、萎缩”。
错误。relapse 意为“（病情）复发、恶化”，语义相反。
正确。shrink 属于“缩减萎缩簇”（dwindle / wane / shrink / slump / plummet），此处指肿瘤体积明显“缩小、萎缩”。

source.sentence: During the trial, tumours stopped growing in 90% of patients, just over 60% of patients had their tumours shrink or disappear, and for about 8% of patients tumours became undetectable on CT scans.
source.title: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as ‘biggest breakthrough in decades’

syntax.backbone: [During the trial 状语], tumours stopped growing ... (分句1), over 60% of patients had their tumours shrink or disappear (分句2), and ... tumours became undetectable (分句3)

segments.text: tumours stopped growing in 90% of patients,
segments.label: 并列分句1

segments.text: just over 60% of patients had their tumours shrink or disappear,
segments.label: 并列分句2（have + O + do）

segments.text: for about 8% of patients tumours became undetectable on CT scans.
segments.label: 并列分句3

translation.literal: 在试验期间，90% 患者的肿瘤停止了生长，略超过 60% 的患者其肿瘤缩小或消失，而且约 8% 患者的肿瘤在 CT 扫描上变得不可检测。
translation.polished: 临床试验期间，90% 受试者的肿瘤停止了生长，逾六成患者的肿瘤出现萎缩甚至消退，更有约 8% 患者的病灶在 CT 影像上已完全检测不到。
translation.keyPoint: have + O + 动词原形（had their tumours shrink）表示经历某种客观变化；三句排比层层递进（停止生长 -> 缩小消失 -> 影像清零），翻译须保留递进层次。

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 促进提升簇
questions.instruction: 阅读演化生物学评论原句，选出与高亮动词 boost 语义最一致的考研阅读同义替换：
questions.prompt: That support pays off: maternal grandmothers tend to boost their grandkids' chances of survival, helping their own genes to live on.

options.explain: 正确。boost 属于“促进提振簇”（foster / boost / spur / propel / bolster），高频替换为 enhance / raise / improve / bolster，意为“提升、增强”。
错误。jeopardize / impair 意为“危及、损害”，与前文 That support pays off（那种支持获得了回报）相反。
错误。offset / neutralize 意为“抵消、中和”，逻辑相反。
错误。scrutinize / inspect 意为“仔细审视、检查”，语义无关。

source.sentence: That support pays off: maternal grandmothers tend to boost their grandkids' chances of survival, helping their own genes to live on.
source.title: Nasa, please send me to the moon. Science says I’m the perfect crew member | Helen Pilcher

syntax.backbone: That support pays off (分句1) : maternal grandmothers (主2) + tend to boost (谓2) + their grandkids' chances of survival (宾2) + [helping ... 结果状语]

segments.text: helping their own genes to live on.
segments.label: 现在分词结果状语

translation.literal: 这种支持取得了回报：外祖母往往会提高她们外孙辈的存活几率，从而帮助自己的基因延续下去。
translation.polished: 这份照料在演化上获得了回报：外祖母的帮扶往往能显著提升外孙辈的存活概率，进而让自身基因得以绵延流传。
translation.keyPoint: pay off（熟词组：获得回报/奏效）；tend to（往往会）；live on（继续存在/延续下去）；冒号起“总—分”阐释作用。

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 强调凸显簇
questions.instruction: 阅读心理健康研究综述原句，选出与高亮动词 highlights 最精准的考研阅读同义替换：
questions.prompt: The practice, sometimes referred to as "drunkorexia", highlights the crossover that can exist between risky drinking behaviour and disordered eating.

options.explain: 错误。conceal / downplay 意为“隐瞒、淡化”，与科研综述揭示两者交叉关联的语义完全相反。

options.text: underscores or brings into sharp focus
options.explain: 正确。highlight 属于“观点强调簇”（highlight / underscore / accentuate / spotlight），考研阅读高频同义替换为 underscore / emphasize / draw attention to。
错误。reverse / eliminate 意为“逆转、消除”，与语境不符。
错误。delay / postpone 意为“推迟、延误”，语义无关。

source.sentence: The practice, sometimes referred to as "drunkorexia", highlights the crossover that can exist between risky drinking behaviour and disordered eating.
source.title: Alcohol addiction and eating disorders often go hand in hand – here’s why

syntax.backbone: The practice [sometimes referred to as "drunkorexia"] (主) + highlights (谓) + the crossover (宾) + [that can exist between ... 定从]

segments.label: 过去分词非限制性定语

segments.text: that can exist between risky drinking behaviour and disordered eating.
segments.label: 定语从句（修饰 crossover）

translation.literal: 这种有时被称为“醉酒厌食症”的做法，凸显了高风险饮酒行为与饮食失调之间可能存在的交叉重叠。

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 固有天生簇
questions.instruction: 结合句中 not innate but passed down from adult males to younger ones 的反义对照，选出与高亮词 innate 语义最贴合的同义替换：
questions.prompt: As in other songbirds, the male's song is not innate but passed down from adult males to younger ones, who sing it throughout their lives to guard territory and find a mate.

options.explain: 错误。acquired 意为“后天习得的”，正是后文 passed down 所表达的反义概念（not innate but passed down）。
错误。fleeting 意为“短暂易逝的”，与后文 sing it throughout their lives 矛盾。
正确。innate 属于“固有天生簇”（inherent / intrinsic / innate / built-in），专指“与生俱来的、天生的”，与后天传授（passed down / acquired）构成经典对立。
错误。redundant 意为“多余冗余的”，与鸣唱用于保卫领地和求偶的关键功能相反。

source.title: Dreams of birds

segments.text: not innate but passed down from adult males to younger ones,
segments.label: not A but B 对照表语

segments.text: who sing it throughout their lives to guard territory and find a mate.
segments.label: 非限制性定语从句（修饰 younger ones）

translation.literal: 与其他鸣禽一样，雄鸟的歌声并非天生的，而是由成年雄鸟传授给幼年雄鸟的，它们终生吟唱这首歌以守护领地和寻找伴侣。
translation.polished: 与其他鸣禽一样，雄鸟的鸣唱并非与生俱来，而是由成年雄鸟代代传授给幼鸟——后者将终生吟唱这套曲调，用以捍卫领地与求偶。
translation.keyPoint: not A but B 是考研阅读猜词题黄金线索：由后文 passed down（后天代代传授）即可反向秒杀 innate = inborn（与生俱来）。

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 无处不在簇
questions.instruction: 阅读科技评测原句，选出与高亮形容词 ubiquitous 语义最贴切的考研阅读同义替换：

questions.examFocus: 阅读同义替换 · 复制模仿簇

translation.literal: 在人工智能时代，别再想着转行当水管工了——如果工程师设法复制了人类双手，那么潜在地没有任何工作能经得起未来的考验。
translation.polished: 在人工智能时代，别再指望转行当水管工来避险了——一旦工程师成功复刻出人类双手，恐怕世上再无任何职业能够高枕无忧。
translation.keyPoint: future-proof 是外刊极高频合成形容词，意为“经得起未来冲击的、不易被时代淘汰的”；manage to do 强调“设法成功做到”。
